title: General Manager
description:
Position Summary:
The General Manager (GM) Airport Operations – International oversees the Customer Service/Airport Operations areas and sets the standard for customer experience. The GM is responsible for the operational performance of the station while achieving or exceeding the established performance measurements. Other responsibilities include coaching, counseling and developing current and potential leaders.
Essential Responsibilities:
Administer the budget of the station and develop cost savings ideas
Participate in airport authority activities as well as attend regular airport meetings
Ensure quality of customer service is in-line with the high expectations customers have for JetBlue
Develop short and long-term vision for department; demonstrates forward-thinking in planning and execution
Participate in ad hoc committees; respond to ad hoc requests to establish, develop or re-visit guidelines, policies and/or procedures as they pertain to the operation or the crewmembers
Assist in establishing and maintaining the annual budget. Manage the Cost per Available Seat Mile (CASM), cost per departure and crewmember productivity hours
Responsible for safety programs at the station to ensure a safe workplace for crewmembers and customers -- responsible for meeting local,state and country requirements
Oversee daily operations, including coordinating and communicating with all departments in regards to operational integrity to improve communication and teamwork to drive efficiencies
Act as Incident/Event Manager during irregular operations, and central point of contact for all station related operational decisions in conjunction/coordination with System Operations
Partner with Director and Airports leadership team in strategy development including overseeing implementation plan(s)
Maintain station operational performance goal monitoring and communications to appropriate departments
Proactively review team performance and recommend enhanced operating practices and procedures to improve performance
Develop balanced metrics to ensure the performance and prosperity targets for the team are achieved and continuously challenged
Take a significant role in the recruitment and development of crewleaders to support their growth and development
Ensure Operations team readiness for response to significant non-routine operations and emergency events
Is accountable to senior management for ensuring the safety and security of ground handling operations
Ensures that policies and procedures are conducted in accordance with applicable federal regulations and standards
Other duties as assigned
Minimum Experience and Qualifications:
High School Diploma or General Education Development (GED) Diploma
Six (6) years of leadership experience with direct responsibility for managing a large customer service operation
Complete fluency in written and spoken English and in the official language of the country in which the position is located.
Proficient with Microsoft Office including Word, Excel, Outlook, and Internet Explorer
Ability to maintain a poised demeanor while working in a fast paced environment
Ability to engage all people and all types of personalities and agendas
Ability to establish credibility and to be decisive
Ability to communicate clearly, concisely, logically and coherently at various levels within the organization
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Results oriented with the ability to balance other business
Strong analytical, numerical, and reasoning abilities
Ability to be hands on with crewmembers, customers, business partners and all other stakeholders
Willing to travel and/or work variable hours, including weekends and irregular shifts
Depending on location, may need to acquire and maintain a United States Customs Clearance
Available for overnight travel (10%)
Must be able to acquire a valid business visa to travel to the United States
Must pass a ten (10) year background check and pre-employment drug test
Must be legally eligible to work in the country in which the position is located
For internal candidates, good standing in attendance performance and safety
Preferred Experience And Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree
Three (3) years of Airline Operations experience
Proven leadership ability with an emphasis on people skills
Excellent organizational and planning skills
Crewmember Expectations:
Regular attendance and punctuality
Potential need to work flexible hours and be available to respond on short-notice
Able to maintain a professional appearance
When working or traveling on JetBlue flights, and if time permits, all capable crewmembers are asked to assist with light cleaning of the aircraft
Must be an appropriate organizational fit for the JetBlue culture, that is, exhibit the JetBlue values of Safety, Caring, Integrity, Passion and Fun
Must fulfill safety accountabilities as prescribed by JetBlue’s Safety Management System
Promote JetBlue’s #1 value of safety as a Safety Ambassador, supporting JetBlue’s Safety Management System (SMS) components, Safety Policy and behavioral standards
Identify safety and/or security concerns, issues, incidents or hazards that should be reported and report them whenever possible and by any means necessary including JetBlue’s confidential reporting systems (Aviation Safety Action Program (ASAP) or Safety Action Report (SAR))
Responsible for adhering to all applicable laws, regulations (FAA, OSHA, DOT, etc.) and Company policies, procedures and risk controls
Uphold JetBlue’s safety performance metric goals and understand how they relate to their duties and responsibilities
The use of ChatGPT or any other automated tool during the interview process will disqualify a candidate from being considered for the position.
Equipment:
Computer and other office equipment
Jetbridge
Ground service equipment, hand held radios, scanners, light emitting diode (LED) signs, mail and cargo equipment as necessary
Working Environment:
Traditional office environment and airport environment
Subject to weather and elevated noise levels
Able to travel and/or work flexible shifts, including holidays and weekends
Shift work and irregular hours due to irregular operations.
Physical Effort:
Moderate physical activity required by handling objects up to fifty (50) pounds frequently and/or seventy to one hundred (70-100) pounds occasionally with the assistance of other people or tools and be in a position where bending, crouching, kneeling, etc. is needed.

title: Vice President – Cash Management and Bilateral Lending Sales
description:
Country: Netherlands
IT STARTS HERE
Santander (www.santander.com) is evolving from a global, high-impact brand intoa technology-driven organization, and our people are at the heart of this journey.
Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible. This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.
Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected totake a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.
Santander Corporate & Investment Banking (Santander CIB) is Santander's global division that supports some of the world's most complex and sophisticatedcorporate and institutional clients, offering customized services and value-added wholesale products to best meet their needs.
THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE
Santander Corporate & Investment Banking is looking for a
Vice President – Cash Management and Bilateral Lending Sales
based out of Amsterdam (Netherlands).
Overview
In this role, you will be part of the GTB department, housed within Santander CIB,who serves as the central hub for originating transaction-driven opportunities across Cash Management, Basic Lending, Export Solutions, and Working Capital Solutions. GTB supports a broad and diverse client landscape, spanning Banking & Corporate Finance (BCF) and Multinationals and International Financial Institutions (IFI).
Within this platform, Cash Management, Liquidity & Lending team delivers a comprehensive suite of treasury solutions designed to help corporates optimize the way they manage accounts, payments, collections, and liquidity - ensuring operational efficiency and robust financial control. This team also handles bilateral loans (Revolving Credit Facilities, Term Loans, Overdrafts, Money Market Lines).
In this position, you will be responsible for the origination, structuring and assistance in the execution of Cash Management mandates for large corporates in the Netherlands (Inbound) and in all other Santander geographies (outbound). You will report to the Head of Cash Management France & Benelux.
The Cash Management Sales will liaise with
Internal stakeholders
Collaborate closely with the coverage team and other internal partners to shape and expand the Dutch cash-management proposition, ensuring we maximise GTB revenues from both existing and newly targeted clients.
Work in partnership with the Global Cash Management team to leverage established relationships and product capabilities from other regions, enabling a consistent and seamless client experience across geographies.
Engage and coordinate all relevant internal stakeholders—product, risk, legal, operations, onboarding, and relationship teams—to strengthen the overall sales effort and accelerate delivery of the Dutch cash-management strategy.
External Stakeholders
Engage proactively with external clients and prospects across thevNetherlands to identify cash-management, bilateral lending needs, deepen relationships, and capture new revenue opportunities for GTB.
Leverage our global network and established client relationships in other regions to introduce best-in-class cash-management solutions into the Netherlands, ensuring a seamless and consistent experience for multinational clients expanding into the region. It should be noted that there is an important element of Group interaction attached to the role of the Cash Management and Bilateral Lending Sales, requiring the ability to develop strong working relationships with management and colleagues throughout the Group in various countries.
Job Description
We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology,
collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:
Leading the design, development and execution of Santander’s global and local cash management strategy across the Netherlands, positioning the bank as a trusted partner for corporates operating or expanding in the region.
Providing specialist support to Coverage teams on complex, cross-border and strategic opportunities, offering expert structuring insight, market guidance, and commercially sound product recommendations.
Establishing and nurture deep relationships with senior treasury and finance decision-makers, actively identifying areas where Santander’s global capabilities can bring meaningful value to large Dutch corporates and multinational organizations.
Acting as the regional thought leader—combining commercial leadership, client engagement, product expertise and strategic oversight—to ensure Santander delivers a distinctive and competitive proposition.
Assisting in the preparation and presentation of client proposals (for beauty parades and RfP), ensuring alignment with client needs and objectives.
Driving growth within the global transactional segment by identifying opportunities to expand our footprint, strengthen client engagement, and enhance the competitiveness of our transactional cash-management offering.
Strengthening collaboration across GTB and SCIB areas - particularly through aligning product, sales, and operational teams, ensuring coordinated delivery, improved client experience and maximized revenue opportunities.
What You’ll Bring
Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organization. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.
The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Profesional Experience
Substantial (8 years or more) experience in Cash Management is preferred. Ideally, this experience will have been gained with a first-class international bank extending Cash Management solutions to the region or possibly from third party providers for Cash Management System Solutions. Experience of commercial situations involving Cash Management, Liquidity Management, etc.: (Required)
A sound understanding of Payment Systems (SEPA; EBA) and SWIFT Methodology related to payments. (Required)
Experience in use of Different Pooling Structures: Zero Balancing, Notional Pooling, Cinderella Sweep, etc. (Required)
Experience of working with global operating Corporates and specific Payment requirements in different Payment areas within the EUR Zone.(Required)
A sound grasp of local law in relation to payments, account structures, pooling structures. (required)
A strong understanding of commercial and financial documentation. (Required)
Strong links and contacts with banks, legal practices, Cash Management System Providers, etc. (Required)
Education
A high general level of education is required (Master of Science) and the successful candidate is very likely to hold qualifications in banking, finance, or economics. (Required)
Languages
Fluent English (Required)
Fluent local language(Preferred)
Spanish and/or any other additional European language within Europe is added value.(Prefered)
Hard Skills
Full proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, and Word).(Required)
Soft Skills
Excellent communications skill; strong on presentation skills; a good team
worker.
Energy, determination and entrepreneurial flair; a real interest in international Payment flows and the economic and political structure and conditions of the region.
A diplomatic but persuasive attitude when dealing with colleagues within the same organisation. The reputation to enhance the Company's standing in international markets.
A team player with an international outlook and the ability to communicate easily across national boundaries.
The ability to react swiftly to adverse and emergency situations, to propose solutions and ensure successful outcomes; an ability to resist high levels of stress.
WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT
Your contribution matters, and it’s recognized. You can expect a fair, competitive reward package that reflects the impact you create and the value you del ver. But we know rewards go beyond numbers.
We’re enable our teams to go beyond through global opportunities and broad career paths.
Learning for life. Access hundreds of courses on our platforms, including exclusive access to our global learning space: Santander Open Academy (www.santanderopenacademy.com)
Competitive rewards. Receive a highly competitive salary with perfor[1]mance based bonuses, motivating you to keep growing with us.
Your health is our priority. Through BeHealthy, our global wellness programme, we promote Holistic wellbeing.
We’re here to keep you motivated, help you reach your goals, and celebrate your progress, every step of the way.
LOCAL COMPLIANCE
Santander is proud of being an organization where there are equal opportunities regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible application process for all candidates.
What To Do Next
If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.

title: Vice President CoE Trade Sales - Studentjob.nl
description:
Your role
As a VP within the Centre of Expertise (CoE) Trade Sales, you will lead the end-to-end sales process and take direct ownership of the implementation and delivery of the full Trade product suite. Acting as Deal Principal, you will be accountable for structuring and executing transactions for clients within your scope, ensuring flawless delivery and commercial impact. You will collaborate closely with the Trade Sales Account Management team to drive seamless execution, maximize client satisfaction, and identify future growth and cross-sell opportunities aligned with strategic objectives.
The product scope entails the wider products offered like the traditional trade products (bank guarantees, (stand‑by) letters of credit as well as different open account working capital products (receivables, supply chain as well as inventory). These products are focused on wholesale banking clients within the Transaction Services product offering. You will be end to end responsible for TFS originations as well as Working Capital originations (receivables, supply chain as well as inventory products).
We work through our dedicated Trade teams based in different EMEA countries as well as New York and across APAC. The scope of the activities will be closely aligned with the Trade Sales CoE in the Netherlands and the Trade Sales Account Management teams.
The country scope of activities will be heavily focused on countries who will not have dedicated Trade Sales in country.
Key responsibilities include cross‑functional collaboration with credit, legal, and sector teams to support client needs and drive scalable and compliant growth in Trade Solutions. Acting as a conduit to product management, you also drive innovation by focusing on selective differentiating themes that reinforce ING’s competitive edge and deliver scalable client impact.
The team
TheCentre of Expertise Trade Sales teamis composed of 10 FTEs in The Netherlands and 7 FTEs in Belgium. You will report into the Head of Trade Sales CoE.
Roles and responsibilities
As VP in Trade, you will lead the structuring and execution of complex transactions as Deal Principal, combining commercial ownership with deep technical expertise across the full spectrum of trade products.
Be the Deal Principal in structuring and implementing Trade transactions. This goes from traditional trade products to open account working capital products (receivables, supply chain as well as inventory). As a VP you will have sales targets with linked implementation responsibilities.
Ensure smooth handover of implemented deals to the Trade Sales Account Management team for ongoing relationship management and post‑deal support.
Analyze client needs, identify opportunities and work out proposals.
Organize client meetings and pitches and make sure your scope of clients is sufficiently covered across all trade products.
Be in the lead of the client interface and be responsible with the internal and external parties involved in the transactions.
You are a technical expert in the matter, be the deal team leader and have experience in leading a transaction structuring process from the front row.
Legal documentation negotiation.
Keep the business safe and compliant. Think along on how to improve our processes from a compliance perspective.
Make the difference to grow the Trade platform.
How to succeed
We recruit talented individuals like you for the potential you bring. Our foremost expectation is that you remain inquisitive—continuously learning and embracing responsibility. In return, we will provide the space and support for your personal development and professional growth.
The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in trade finance; you strive to bring fresh ideas to life and embrace challenges in a fast changing and complex environment. You are a naturally collaborative person who listens and invests in others to achieve common goals. You love to challenge the status quo and are eager to propose creative solutions to problems.
As a VP you will also need:
to be commercially driven
a relevant experience of around 6‑9 years within either securitization, a structured finance equivalent role, a Wholesale Banking product role, a Wholesale Banking sales position or in Risk Management.
a strong background in trade finance and open account trade
a strong background in credit risk and deal structuring/-execution
excellent oral and written skills in English
an academic degree in economics, management, law, engineering or equivalent
ability to communicate in other European languages, alongside English, is advantageous
Rewards and benefits
We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. You can find out more about our employment conditions at Benefits in the Netherlands.
The benefits of working with us at ING include:
A salary tailored to your qualities and experience
24‑28 vacation days depending on contract
Pension scheme
13th month salary
Individual Savings Contribution (BIS), 3.5% of your gross annual salary
8% Holiday payment
Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co‑creation
Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
An informal working environment with innovative colleagues
About Us
With 60,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help people take a step ahead in life and in business. Do you want to work at the cutting edge of what’s possible and at the same time ensure you work with integrity and hold the customer’s interests at heart? Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse, and supportive colleagues? Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING. Join us. Apply today.

title: Algemeen Directeur bij Oranjedak in Zwijndrecht
description:
Oranjedak
Oranjedak behoort tot de sterkste spelers in de Nederlandse dakbedekkingsbranche. De organisatie onderscheidt zich door innovatie, hoge kwaliteit, veiligheid, duurzaamheid, professioneel advies en langdurige partnerships. Vanuit een integraal totaalconcept levert Oranjedak duurzame dakoplossingen in zowel aanleg als beheer en onderhoud. De omzet bedraagt circa € 60 miljoen en wordt gerealiseerd met renovatie, nieuwbouw, zonnepanelen en beheer- en onderhoudsdiensten.
De organisatie telt vijf vestigingen en circa 250 professionals, zowel vast als flexibel. Vakmanschap en betrokkenheid van medewerkers vormen de basis van het succes. Daarom investeert Oranjedak continu in groei, veiligheid en welzijn. Het vergroten van kennis, prestaties en betrokkenheid staat daarbij centraal.
Oranjedak maakt onderdeel uit van de Primutec Solutions Group (PSG), een collectief van zelfstandige en toonaangevende bedrijven in dakservices, duurzame zonne-energie en bliksembeveiliging. De bedrijven opereren autonoom, met ruimte voor de eigen identiteit, en versterken elkaar door het delen van kennis, expertise en schaalvoordelen.
Sinds 2025 is Trill Impact aandeelhouder binnen de groep met een sterke focus op duurzaamheid. Cees de Wijs is recent aangetreden als CEO van PSG. Zijn focus ligt op het creëren van duurzame waarde door het optimaliseren van de verbinding tussen de bedrijven. Vanuit kracht samenwerken, overeenkomsten benutten en tegelijkertijd recht doen aan de verschillen tussen de bedrijven, vormt daarbij het uitgangspunt.
Tot en met 2023 stond de voormalig DGA aan het roer van Oranjedak. Daarna werd de dagelijkse leiding gevoerd door een Algemeen Directeur, die recent heef aangekondigd Oranjedak te verlaten. In deze volgende fase zoekt Oranjedak een Algemeen Directeur die richting geeft en stabiliteit brengt. Participatie behoort daarbij tot de mogelijkheden en onderstreept het gezamenlijke streven naar duurzame waarde creatie en lange termijnbetrokkenheid binnen PSG..
Algemeen Directeur
Als Algemeen Directeur ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor de strategie, resultaten en verdere ontwikkeling van Oranjedak. Je brengt richting en overzicht en zorgt voor samenhang en structuur. Dat doe je zonder de ondernemende kracht en identiteit van de organisatie te verliezen. Met scherp zakelijk inzicht positioneer je Oranjedak toekomstgericht in deze volgende fase. Daarbij hoort een vernieuwende blik. Je volgt ontwikkelingen in de markt en technologie op de voet en denkt actief mee over duurzame en toekomstbestendige oplossingen. Je ziet vernieuwing niet als doel op zich, maar als middel om Oranjedak wendbaar, relevant en onderscheidend te houden.
Een belangrijk speerpunt is het vergroten van grip en voorspelbaarheid. Je brengt heldere structuren aan, maakt verantwoordelijkheden expliciet en zorgt voor een consistente besluitvorming. Dat doe je over vestigingen, disciplines en processen heen. Je versterkt de juridische en organisatorische inrichting en zorgt voor transparantie in afspraken, prestaties en resultaten.
Je stuurt nadrukkelijk op een gezondere en evenwichtigere orderportefeuille. De focus verschuift naar een betere portfolio mix, met meer terugkerende business vanuit onderhoud en renovatie, naast nieuwbouw. Dit leidt tot een stabielere planning, een beter gevulde pijplijn en een robuustere basis voor groei en rendement. Samen met de commerciële, technische en financiële organisatie bewaak je marges, haalbaarheid en uitvoerbaarheid.
Je gelooft sterk in eigenaarschap lager in de organisatie. Door duidelijke kaders te stellen en tegelijkertijd ruimte te geven voor initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid, bouw je aan zelfredzame, volwassen teams met duidelijke regelruimte.
Daarnaast ben je de aanjager van verdere groei en ontwikkeling. Je geeft richting aan commerciële slagkracht, marktpositionering en samenwerking, zowel binnen Oranjedak als met de zusterbedrijven binnen de groep. Je ziet kansen voor synergie en kennisdeling en weet waarde te creëren op de verbinding, met blijvende aandacht voor focus, prestaties en identiteit.
Je beweegt je soepel binnen de dynamiek van Primutec Solutions Group en begrijpt de rol van aandeelhouder Trill Impact in deze fase. Je rapporteert aan de CEO van de groep en draagt bij aan groepsbrede ambities, terwijl je scherp blijft op het belang en de positionering van Oranjedak.
Je geeft direct leiding aan de Commercieel Directeur, Technisch Directeur en HR Directeur. Samen vormen jullie een complementair leiderschapsteam dat richting geeft, keuzes maakt en de organisatie meeneemt in verandering.
Je hebt oog voor waar Oranjedak vandaan komt. Je herkent gevoeligheden, informele lijnen en het verleden, maar laat je daar niet door leiden. Met respect voor het bestaande breng je rust en duidelijkheid en bouw je aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de volgende stap. Daarbij durf je bestaande kaders ter discussie te stellen en processen te moderniseren, met blijvend respect voor de kern en identiteit van Oranjedak.
De kandidaat
Je bent een ervaren algemeen directeur met aantoonbare eindverantwoordelijkheid voor strategie, resultaten en mensen binnen een projectgedreven organisatie. Je voelt je thuis in een ondernemende mkb-omgeving van deze omvang, waar nabijheid, tempo en pragmatiek essentieel zijn. Tegelijkertijd begrijp je hoe een groepsstructuur met aandeelhouders, governance en duidelijke verwachtingen functioneert.
Je overziet de samenhang tussen commercie, operatie en finance. Je stuurt bewust op rendement, kasstromen, risicobeheersing en voorspelbaarheid. Strategische keuzes vertaal je naar concrete besluiten en heldere prioriteiten in de dagelijkse praktijk.
Je beschikt over ruime ervaring met P&L-eindverantwoordelijkheid op directieniveau en bent gewend leiding te geven aan een senior managementteam. Je creëert duidelijkheid over rollen en verantwoordelijkheden, stimuleert eigenaarschap en laat ruimte voor zelfstandige besluitvorming. Je bent zichtbaar en benaderbaar, zonder structureel commerciële en/of operationele taken naar je toe te trekken.
Je combineert academisch werk- en denkniveau met sterke bedrijfskundige en financiële vaardigheden en een duidelijke technische affiniteit. Je begrijpt projectorganisaties en kent de dynamiek van de bouw- of bouwgerelateerde sector. Ervaring binnen het mkb en in organisaties die zich ontwikkelen van ondernemend naar meer gestructureerd en professioneel sluit goed aan.
Als persoon ben je proactief, betrouwbaar en open. Je bent pragmatisch en oplossingsgericht, veerkrachtig in complexe situaties en verbindend in je stijl, zonder conflict te mijden. Je maakt af waar je aan begint en bent duidelijk en transparant richting mensen, ook wanneer keuzes of veranderingen dat vragen.
Je investeert actief in samenwerking en relaties, binnen Oranjedak, met zusterbedrijven binnen de groep en met externe stakeholders. Je denkt in het grotere geheel en stimuleert synergie, terwijl je scherp blijft op focus, prestaties en duurzame waardecreatie.
Je bent ondernemend ingesteld en bereid om te participeren. Je voelt je medeverantwoordelijk voor de lange termijn en bent intrinsiek gemotiveerd om duurzame waarde te creëren voor de organisatie, haar medewerkers en de groep als geheel.
Procedure
Spreekt dit verhaal je aan, word je nieuwsgierig of wil je van gedachten wisselen?
Novesta verzorgt exclusief de werving en selectie voor deze positie. Voor meer informatie en solliciteren kun je contact opnemen met Arjan Sibma, as@novesta.nl of 06-28539717.

title: General Manager Treinreizen
description:
Bouw mee aan de toekomst van luxe en bijzondere treinreizen wereldwijd binnen onze reisspecialistengroep. Ben jij een strategische leider die een groeiende organisatie naar een hoger niveau kan brengen? De komende jaren liggen er ambitieuze plannen voor Destin Treinreizen, waarbij verdere professionalisering en uitbreiding centraal staan. Daarom zoeken we een General Manager die richting geeft, structuur aanbrengt en de organisatie meeneemt in deze ontwikkelfase. Jij houdt overzicht, stuurt op resultaat en bouwt tegelijkertijd aan de processen, structuren en teams die nodig zijn om duurzaam te groeien. Met jouw visie, energie en ondernemerschap zorg je ervoor dat Destin Treinreizen uitgroeit tot een nog sterker, toekomstbestendig merk binnen onze reisspecialistengroep. Samen met de directie bepaal je de koers, realiseer je groei en leid je het team naar een hoge mate van klanttevredenheid en resultaat. Je ontwikkelt en inspireert medewerkers, bouwt duurzame relaties met keypartners en leveranciers en zorgt dat Destin Treinreizen vandaag én morgen succesvol is.
Wat wij verwachten
Je ontwikkelt en implementeert de strategie voor Destin Treinreizen in lijn met de bedrijfsdoelstellingen en vertaalt marktontwikkelingen naar concrete groeikansen en concurrentiekansen.
Je signaleert actief nieuwe markten en commerciële mogelijkheden en weet deze om te zetten in duurzame omzetgroei.
Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de omzet, kosten, marge, winstgevendheid en de kwaliteit van financiële rapportages richting directie.
Je optimaliseert processen, systemen en servicelevels zodat de afdeling efficiënt werkt, compliant is en een uitstekende klantbeleving levert.
Je stuurt sales- en marketingactiviteiten aan, versterkt de commerciële performance en onderhoudt sterke relaties met keypartners en leveranciers.
Je zorgt voor een dynamisch en toekomstbestendig productportfolio door bestaande treinreisconcepten door te ontwikkelen én nieuwe bestemmingen en vernieuwende concepten te lanceren.
Je bouwt een toekomstbestendige organisatie door verbeterinitiatieven te ontwikkelen en te implementeren.
Je geeft leiding aan het team, stimuleert samenwerking, innovatie en klantgerichtheid en coacht medewerkers in hun groei en ontwikkeling.
Je begeleidt verander- en verbetertrajecten en zorgt tegelijkertijd voor een stabiele, kwalitatieve en goed geplande operationele organisatie.
Wat breng je mee?
Je bent bij voorkeur fulltime beschikbaar (39 uur)
Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een soortgelijke functie
Sterk strategisch en analytisch inzicht
Ervaring met eindverantwoordelijkheid voor financiële resultaten
Inspirerend en besluitvaardig leiderschap
Ondernemende mindset en commerciële slagkracht
Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel intern als extern
Jouw werkomgeving
Je opereert in een dynamische en concurrerende markt waarin commerciële, operationele en strategische belangen samenkomen. Je krijgt veel zelfstandigheid om keuzes te maken en processen te optimaliseren, terwijl je nauw samenwerkt met directie, interne stakeholders en externe partners. In deze rol heb je directe impact op groei, continuïteit en klanttevredenheid.
Wat wij jou bieden
Werken in een ambitieuze en groeiende organisatie
Ruimte voor ondernemerschap, innovatie en eigen initiatief
Een betrokken team en korte lijnen met directie
Een goed salaris van maximaal €7.000 bruto per maand op basis van 39 uur per week
Snel een vast contract
Een succesafhankelijke bonusregeling
Jaarlijks studiebudget voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling
Pensioenregeling waarvan 50% door de werkgever betaald wordt
Gratis reisverzekering
Jaarlijks op studiereis, zo weet je precies wat wij doen
25 vakantiedagen
Laptop en mobiele telefoon van de zaak
Sollicitatieprocedure
Klaar om het verschil te maken in treinreizen? Stuur dan voor 31 maart 2026 je CV en motivatiebrief naar hr@destintravel.nl t.a.v. Boudewijn van Pelt en bouw samen met ons aan een succesvolle toekomst voor onze luxe en bijzondere treinreizen waarmee we onze klanten keer op keer weten te verrassen.
Over ons
Als luxe reisspecialistengroep zijn we, met meer dan 50 jaar ervaring, gespecialiseerd in unieke reisbelevenissen op het gebied van luxe treinreizen, zeecruises, muziekreizen, aircruises en riviercruises. Dit doen we met een passie voor reizen, een hoog verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en een servicegerichte houding in een omgeving waarin samenwerken, eerlijkheid, kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid onze kernwaarden zijn. Met meer dan 45 collega's zorgen wij ervoor dat onze klant altijd weer in staat is om een unieke reisbelevenis met ons te ervaren.

title: Vice President EMEA Segment Sales for Data Center
description:
Eaton’s EMEA Sales & Marketing organisation is seeking a Vice President EMEA Segment Sales for Data Center.
What You’ll Do
Eaton Corporation is seeking a Vice President EMEA Segment Sales for Data Center to join our EMEA Electrical Sector Sales and Field Marketing organization. Reporting to the VP EMEA Sales & Marketing, the leader will be responsible for defining and driving execution of sales and market strategies for Datacenters across the EMEA region. They will lead the development and implementation of technology, process, and talent strategies across the organization to support the achievement of our objectives.
This role is responsible for driving Eaton's success and standing the data centre industry. They will build and manage a commercial team that is highly proficient in securing and delivering products, services & solutions into often large, multi-country, complex and mission-critical data center projects. The leader is responsible for Data Centre Segment sales and business growth across the EMEA region, covering large national and international Hyperscale, Colocation and Enterprise data centers. As the commercial leader, they are expected to directly manage an extended sales team and to ensure effective collaboration across various internal stakeholders, namely product business units, quotation engineering, project management and services, segment marketing and country sales organisations. The business focuses on customer account management and ensuring effective engagement with consultants and contractors, achieved through formal, structured engagement programs. As the majority of customers are international, part of this role is ensuring effective support and liaison with other Eaton regions (APAC, Americas) together with the Global Segment Market lead.
Job Responsibilities
Business Performance
Responsible for Eaton's overall Data Center commercial performance in terms of sales revenue, growth, profitability and market share. Responsible for reaching Eaton commercial targets in the Data Center segment. Responsible for ensuring success across the full breadth of Eaton's Data Center portfolio i.e. critical electrical power systems and digital systems. Ensure growth in terms of the number of clients and countries served. In order to achieve this success, effective collaboration and team work is required across all supporting functions such as quotations and bid response, project management, commissioning and post installation services. This commercial oversight is an key responsibility as it assures continued commercial success.
Sales Management
Responsible for building, supporting and managing the performance of a direct sales team. This team generally consists of key account managers spread across EMEA. Responsibility for the creation, communication and implementation of an effective sales growth plan and the associated customer account plans. Key metrics being revenue growth, profitability, new account acquisition, new territories, overall sales proficiency. Ensures effective reporting of the above to Segment and Regional Leadership. Effectively collaborates with the other regions to support global account business and the associated global accounts program.
Commercial Management
Oversee and support the overall effectiveness and the "segment appropriate" nature of key adjacent functions for example tender proposals, commercial offers and contracts, project management, services and marketing. Responsible directly and indirectly to secure Eaton interests through effective negotiation with both internal and external groups and for building the essential credibility and trust with clients and stakeholders.
Data Centre Strategy
Engage and support the Data Center segment strategy market leader, and the various business units with attributes of the Data Center market and customers that impact Eaton at product, application and offer level. Oversee the effective operation and utilization of engineering quotation engineers for generating tender proposals and commercial offers.
Pre-Sales Engineering
Support and manage the pre-sales engineering team. This team is responsible for working with clients, consultants and contractors covering all the engineering aspects of Eaton's portfolio with respect to Data Center design, build and operations. In addition to securing 'spec position' with clients this team shall play a vital role in delivering on Eaton engineering value proposition.
Extended Account Teams
In order to ensure client success, key account managers build cross-functional extended account teams. Responsible to oversee and support key account managers in this regard and ensure that effective teams are formed. This is essential for large multinational projects and accounts.
Location:
This role can be based in a number of locations across the EMEA region, with flexibility for a hybrid work pattern. International travel to spend time with customers, and for team leadership and operational alignment is essential.
Qualifications
Education level required
Bachelor's degree in Science or Engineering
Years And Area Of Experience Required
10+ years of related experience in the 3 phase UPS Data Center business
Skills
Technical knowledge
Demonstrated ability to inspire and coordinate others. The position requires entrepreneurial spirit, a high degree of customer affinity and very strong influencing skills
Strong executive presence and ability to relate well as a peer to leaders of target customers
Must be able to take a leadership role in driving change
Must be able to identify and implement new tools and processes
We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

title: Vice President, Credit Officer Leveraged Finance
description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?
Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.
With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.
Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.
Would you like to work for one of the World's largest banks in an exciting, dynamic and international environment?
We are currently recruiting for a Credit Officer Leveraged Finance in Amsterdam.
About MUFG
Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc. (MUFG) is one of the world’s leading financial groups. Headquartered in Tokyo and with over 360 years of history, MUFG has a global network with approximately 2,000 locations in more than 40 countries. The Group has about 120,000 employees and offers services including commercial banking, trust banking, securities, credit cards, consumer finance, asset management, and leasing. The Group aims to “be the world’s most trusted financial group” through close collaboration among our operating companies and flexibly respond to all of the financial needs of our customers, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world. MUFG’s shares trade on the Tokyo, Nagoya, and New York stock exchanges. For more information, visit https://www.mufg.jp/english.
About MUFG Bank (Europe) N.V.
MUFG Bank (Europe) N.V. (MBE) is a fully-owned subsidiary of MUFG Bank, headquartered in Amsterdam. With offices throughout Europe, our teams provide clients with comprehensive financing solutions spanning Coverage & Structured Finance, Capital Markets and Transaction Banking, using MUFG’s global reach to provide bespoke solutions. With 73 green, sustainability, sustainability-linked and transition bond tranches in 2021 and 51 sustainability-linked loans in EMEA in 2021, MUFG is committed to supporting clients to achieve sustainable business growth.
Please visit our website for more information – https://www.mufgemea.com/mbe
Your impact at MUFG
As part of our credit office team, you’ll play a key role in safeguarding MUFG’s credit portfolio while enabling sustainable growth. You’ll assess credit proposals and ratings for Corporate & Structured Lending and Leveraged Finance transactions across Europe, ensuring alignment with our risk appetite and regulatory standards. By developing deep insight into our portfolios, you’ll make informed recommendations to senior management and contribute to a strong control environment. Your collaboration with colleagues across Credit Risk, EMEA Risk Management, and global MUFG functions will help maintain the integrity of our credit decisions and support our strategic ambitions.
Function positioning
Credit office is a 2nd line of defence function responsible for corporate banking credit for Japanese as well as non-Japanese corporates financial institutions and sovereigns.
Its major functions are outlined as follows:
Assessment and management of credit risks and related risks
Monitoring, reporting and early action
Portfolio analysis and management
The role includes the following:
Conduct detailed credit and rating analysis across assigned sectors and products, including drafting credit papers, applying rating methodologies, and preparing comparative data (e.g., statistics, graphs, tables).
Assess credit proposals objectively, identifying key risk factors and providing clear recommendations for senior management approval.
Challenge proposed transactions and credit recommendations to ensure a balanced approach between risk, return, and capital usage.
Act as a credit counterpart to 1st line of defence sector leads, relationship managers, and product teams.
Provide timely, concise credit advice and briefings, both written and verbal, to senior stakeholders.
Collaborate proactively with front-office teams on deal-specific and strategic matters, identifying red flags and ensuring policy compliance.
Work closely with MUFG credit divisions and the EMEA Credit Risk team to foster a unified “one team” approach.
Support the development of MBE’s credit risk framework, including risk appetite, portfolio monitoring, and early warning systems.
Assist senior credit leadership in shaping risk appetite frameworks and credit policies.
Stay informed on market trends, sector developments, and financial/legal structures to anticipate risks and mitigate potential losses.
Mentor junior colleagues and share technical expertise across allocated sectors and products.
Maintain strong communication with business lines and other stakeholders to support strategic initiatives and client engagement.
Contribute to cross-functional projects and internal forums, providing expert credit risk input.
In order to be successful in the role, you will need the following:
Minimal 7 years of work experience in the financial services industry carrying out credit work for corporate and structured / leveraged finance.
Understanding of regulatory requirements related to the credit sanctioning and monitoring process.
Extensive knowledge of Corporate and Structured / Leveraged structures and related (LMA) documentation.
In depth knowledge of credit and risk principles, products, derivatives and management
Strong interpersonal skills. The role demands close liaison with other credit divisions, front offices and senior management; pro-actively develop and maintain such relationships.
Verbal and written communication skills in English is essential.
Strong numerical skills and attention to detail and accuracy.
Personal requirements:
Integrity and Responsibility
Balance Risk with Opportunity
Customer Focus
Demonstrate Global Perspective
Professionalism and Teamwork
Drive For Results
Collaborate and Build Partnerships
Communicate Effectively and Professionally
Challenge Ourselves To Grow
Influence and Inspire Others
Lead Change & Seek Continuous Improvement
Think Strategically
Manage and Develop Talent
What do we have to offer:
We offer you a role in one of the largest banks of the world in a growing and international environment. You have various opportunities to develop yourself and we will support you with that by offering various training and development possibilities.
We take into account your home situation and your ambitions and help you to balance work and private life.
Monthly team events.
To work in an ambitious, international environment with colleagues from different countries and cultures who strive for the best.
Besides that we will offer you:
Gross salary based on experience and consistent with the market
8% holiday allowance and 13th month payment.
30 vacation days per year. Optional you can buy 15 additional days.
Commuting allowance based on annual public transport 2nd class, most economical way, or € 0,23 per km with a max of 75 km one way.
€ 5,00 net remote working compensation per day, with a maximum of € 60,00 per month.
Possibility to order a mobile phone (up to € 800,-)
Possibility to order Office Equipment’s for the home office, (up to € 500,-)
Remote Working Policy i.e. Working From Home (WFH) and Remote Working in another Country.
Bicycle plan (fiscal benefit)
Company fitness (fiscal benefit)
Mental health workshops and budget for external courses (i.e. Dutch language classes).
Employee contribution towards Pension insurance (max 5%, currently 2%), our pension scheme is based on a defined contribution scheme.
Training & development possibilities paid by the bank
Additional information
:
Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated.
The role is based in the Netherlands. All candidates need to be willing to relocate to the Netherlands. Internal employees will be supported in case of relocation.
We are open to considering flexible working requests in line with organisational requirements.
MUFG is committed to embracing diversity and building an inclusive culture where all employees are valued, respected and their opinions count. We support the principles of equality, diversity and inclusion in recruitment and employment, and oppose all forms of discrimination on the grounds of age, sex, gender, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy and maternity, race, gender reassignment, religion or belief and marriage or civil partnership.
We make our recruitment decisions in a non-discriminatory manner in accordance with our commitment to identifying the right skills for the right role and our obligations under the law.

title: General Manager(Roving)
description:
About Stamford Hotels And Resorts
Stamford Hotels and Resorts, a part of the Stamford Group, manages the Group’s portfolio of luxury premium hotels located in Australia. The hotel portfolio consists of nearly 1800 rooms and over 1000 employees. In addition to the hotels, the Stamford Group owns a portfolio of premium commercial office properties internationally, and is involved in the development of high end luxury residential units in Australia.
At Stamford Hotels and Resorts, we understand that our people are our greatest asset. We strive to retain, develop and reward passionate and success-orientated professionals at all levels. In our pursuit for excellence, we encourage entrepreneurial thinking, challenge the status quo and inculcate a sense of ownership while fostering an environment of transparency, collaboration, respect and integrity among our employees, business partners and the larger community.
About The Role
General Manager (Roving) provides strategic leadership and operational oversight across multiple hotel properties within the Group. This position is critical in ensuring operational excellence, delivering exceptional guest experiences, driving financial performance, and fostering team development across multiple hotel properties within the Group.
Core Requirements Of Your Role
Strategic Leadership & Business Performance
Lead the overall operational strategic direction of the hotel and ensure alignment with company goals.
Oversee the financial performance of the property, including revenue generation, cost control, and profitability.
Develop and implement business plans to maximise room and F&B revenue and overall ROI.
Lead initiatives to enhance guest experience and operational efficiency.
Ensure alignment of each property’s business strategy with Group objectives and brand positioning.
Marketing Performance & Effectiveness
Review and approve marketing innovations, strategies and campaigns to achieve the most effective reach for Rooms and F&B target audiences.
Work closely with the marketing and sales team to execute practical, data-driven marketing initiatives that drive occupancy and F&B sales.
Ensure each marketing campaign achieves the desired ROI
Guest Satisfaction
Oversee the hotel’s service quality and guest satisfaction level ensuring continuous improvement across all touchpoints.
Promote a guest-centric culture by empowering department heads and front-line teams to deliver memorable experiences.
Lead regular operational reviews to ensure continuous improvement and compliance
Strategy Planning and Execution
Review the hotel’s products, services and offerings to identify opportunities for operational enhancement and improve financial performance.
Regularly assess the effectiveness of the hotel’s current organisational structure, staffing and management systems, recommending alternatives to improve efficiency and profitability.
Drive the execution of approved corporate projects and strategic initiatives for the hotel, and ensure they are followed through by the HODs.
Oversee financial performance management, including revenue reporting, cost control, and adherence to approved budgets.
Compliance
Ensure the hotels are compliant with company policies, procedures (e.g., Code of Conduct), and all applicable external laws, regulations, standards and industry codes with emphasis on health and liquor compliance.
Implementation and adherence of compliance requirements into day-to-day operation
Standard Operating Procedures
Ensure consistent implementation of SOPs across the departments.
Promote best practice sharing among hotels. Facilitate communication across properties to optimise operations and standardisation
Develop Hotel Management Teams
Review the competencies and effectiveness of HODs; train, develop and guide the hotel management teams to be fluent in their understanding of hotel and F&B operations.
Ensure effective workforce planning, succession planning, and staff development initiatives are in place.
Foster a positive work environment that promotes diversity, inclusion, and team recognition initiatives.
Other duties, tasks and projects as assigned
Requirements
Bachelor’s Degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or related field.
Proficient in English.
Minimum 10 years of progressive hotel management experience, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership or GM role.
Strong financial acumen and strategic thinking.Excellent communication, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
Hands-on experience Rooms and/ or Food & Beverage management
Experience in contractor/ vendor management
Experience in leading a large team of staff is a must
Proven ability to lead large teams and manage key stakeholders.
Willingness and ability to travel interstate at short notice
How To Apply
If you have the experience, we'll give you the opportunity. Please submit a cover letter and resume. We thank you in advance for taking the time to apply, please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.
No recruitment agencies please.
Stamford Hotels and Resorts is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive, people-first culture. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, covered under applicable law.
#SHR
Apply Now

title: Senior Medical Monitor (MD)
description:
About The Job
At Danone, our mission is clear "
Bringing health through food to as many people as possible
". We combine science, purpose, and innovation to develop evidence‑based nutritional solutions that support healthier lives and a healthier planet. As part of our international Clinical Research function, the Senior Medical Monitor has a pivotal role in ensuring participant safety, shaping medical‑safety strategy, and contributing to globally impactful nutrition science.
About The Role
As a Senior Medical Monitor, you serve as an expert medical safety leader. You oversee complex clinical studies, act as an escalation point for junior team members, lead safety governance, and provide advanced medical judgment in safety evaluations. You influence safety strategy, represent Medical Safety in cross‑functional forums, and contribute to continuously improving clinical safety processes across the organization.
This role combines medical oversight, strategic influence, and matrix-level cross‑functional leadership, providing a unique opportunity to shape the safety and development of Danone’s global nutrition portfolio.
Key Responsibilities & Impact Areas
Represent Medical Safety in strategic forums and global project teams, contributing medical insight to program decisions.
Provide expert medical oversight across multiple complex clinical studies, ensuring medical scientific integrity and participant safety
Co-writes, reviews, and approves core clinical documents (protocols, product information, safety reports, study reports) from a medical and safety perspective.
Perform medical monitoring activities, ensuring protocol adherence, GCP compliance, and high-quality execution across studies.
Evaluate complex SAEs, providing clear medical judgement on causality, expectedness, and risk impact.
Lead safety governance, including cross-functional safety reviews and proactive risk-mitigation actions
Ensure alignment with senior internal and external stakeholders (including investigators, contract research organisations, and other partners) to support high-quality medical execution.
Drive continuous improvement of safety evaluation processes, implementing new methodologies, and staying current with evolving regulations, guidelines, and scientific developments
Mentor and guide cross-functional teams, fostering clinical safety principles and best practices.
About you
We welcome applicants who bring strong medical and clinical‑research experience and are motivated to grow within nutritional clinical development.
The ideal candidate will have
A Medical Doctor's (MD) degree
A solid clinical background, either through direct patient care experience or through continuous medical education ensuring current clinical knowledge.
Significant experience in international clinical research, ideally in medical monitoring, clinical safety, or related areas.
Experience in nutrition or therapeutic areas related to Danone’s product portfolio is a plus.
Deep knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical-trial methodology, safety signal detection, and regulatory expectations.
Proven ability to collaborate and influence senior cross-functional stakeholders in a global matrix environment.
Confidence working with digital tools, data‑driven safety evaluation, and emerging technologies.
Excellent written and spoken English with the ability to communicate complex clinical information clearly.
What We Offer
Hybrid working model
Opportunity to contribute to scientifically robust products that enhance health and quality of life
A collaborative, purpose-driven scientific environment
Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning
About us
Working at Danone is a unique experience. It’s fast-paced and complex, and at times, it can be challenging. But it’s packed with opportunities to learn and grow, working with some of the best-known brands in the world, like Evian, Alpro, Nutricia, Activia, and Nutrilon. Bring your unique perspective, ambitions, and entrepreneurial ideas to the table – the impact you could make might just surprise you. One Planet. One Health – BY YOU.
We’re proud to be a B-Corp certified company. That means we meet the highest verified standards of social and environmental performance, transparency, and accountability in everything we do. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we base our hiring decisions on merit, job requirements, and business needs.
What’s Next?
Are you the person we are looking for? Hit the “apply now” button.
To comply with GDPR regulations, we cannot process your personal data without given consent. Therefore, we strongly recommend applying directly via our career website.
Need more information? Please contact Robin Hiariej, Talent Manager via robin.hiariej@danone.com.
All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

title: Vice President Of Products, IgniteTech (Remote) - $400,000/year USD
description:
You're a product executive with a track record of delivery. You take a defined product vision, decompose it into the smallest units of value, and ship enterprise-ready AI functionality quickly—without letting the process devolve into roadmap performance art. You've already experienced the "AI fixes everything" wave, understand where it fails, and know how to build regardless. If your strongest contributions emerge when you control the full outcome (deciding, prototyping, hardening, launching, and observing actual customer usage), this role warrants your attention.
The broader software industry approaches AI like a superficial overlay: add a chatbot interface, launch a "copilot," label it innovation, and hope purchasers don't probe too deeply. Our approach is fundamentally different. We construct AI-native functionality that justifies its inclusion by producing quantifiable enterprise impact, and we execute at a pace that makes conventional planning appear self-destructive. Our advantage lies in accelerating Sell → Design → Build cycles, disciplined scope management within a clear strategic direction, and production releases that satisfy enterprise requirements without prolonged coordination delays.
This role centers on the swift delivery of enterprise-caliber, AI-native product capabilities directly to customers. It involves personally building prototypes with current AI tools to confirm technical viability before engineering solidifies the implementation. It means owning the complete delivery arc from vision clarification through production launch, making critical tradeoff decisions, and shipping within defined constraints. It does not mean "attaching AI features" absent a concrete value case. It is not a feature-request intake operation, a requirements-document factory, or a presentation-driven career. It does not involve abstract vision rhetoric, model performance indicators disconnected from user outcomes, or assumptions that AI functions flawlessly.
You'll work closely with engineering in a player-coach capacity: part hands-on builder, part decision authority, zero parts process coordinator. You'll convert an established strategic vision into actionable scope, prototype rapidly to eliminate uncertainty, and deliver releases that customers can genuinely deploy in authentic enterprise settings. If you've launched original enterprise software, leveraged AI as an execution mechanism, and remain composed when industry hype confronts production realities, you'll receive the autonomy to execute quickly and the accountability to ensure durability. If that description feels like opportunity rather than burden, we encourage your application.
What You Will Be Doing
Shipped Product Capabilities: Original or significantly improved product features released to production and available to enterprise customers
AI-Driven Prototypes: Functional prototypes built using AI as the principal execution mechanism to confirm viability before production hardening
Enterprise-Grade Production Deployments: Completely hardened, secure, dependable deployments that satisfy enterprise expectations for quality, usability, and security
What You Won’t Be Doing
Portfolio management or roadmap-focused product leadership
Customer discovery as the principal directional input
Process-intensive or governance-centered product roles
Using AI solely as an assistive tool rather than a fundamental execution layer
Vice President Of Products Key Responsibilities
Swift delivery of enterprise-caliber, AI-native product capabilities directly into customer environments
Basic Requirements
Minimum 5 years of experience delivering new products or substantial capabilities from inception through completion
Demonstrated ownership of product delivery spanning vision refinement to production deployment
Proven experience prototyping, validating, and iterating products or features with modern AI tooling
Track record of upholding enterprise-software standards for quality, security, reliability, and deployment
About IgniteTech
World-class talent. 100% global remote.
Ready to be a part of the top talent that IgniteTech has curated from thousands of applicants throughout the world? Come join us.
Through our portfolio of leading enterprise software solutions, we ignite business performance for thousands of customers globally. We’re big believers in the remote-work-from-anywhere lifestyle, which creates freedom for our team members and enables us to hire the best and brightest from around the world. A career with IgniteTech is challenging and fast-paced and we’re always looking for energetic and enthusiastic team members.
We’re an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity employer and we value the strength that diversity brings to our workplace.

title: Algemeen directeur
description:
Jij ziet kansen vóór anderen ze zien. En je zet ze om in resultaat. Met scherpe keuzes, commerciële slagkracht en een mensgerichte aanpak breng jij Indicia Betawerk naar de volgende fase: groeien, professionaliseren én integreren binnen Indicia. Met behoud van de eigen identiteit.
Wat ga je doen?
Jij bent de regisseur van Betawerk. Je zet de koers uit, brengt rust en focus en zorgt dat plannen niet op papier blijven hangen, maar zichtbaar resultaat worden. Je stuurt het managementteam aan, neemt besluiten en houdt de organisatie scherp op performance: van omzet en marge tot kosten en forecasting.
Tegelijk ben jij de commerciële aanjager. Je spot kansen, ontwikkelt proposities, bouwt aan een sterke marktpositie (in lijn met Indicia) en bouwt relaties met key accounts en strategische partners. Je houdt de pipeline gezond, stuurt op sales en zorgt dat pricing en conversie kloppen.
En dan is er nog de integratie; de uitdaging waarin jij het verschil maakt. Jij leidt Betawerk door de integratiefase binnen Indicia, zonder dat het eigen karakter verloren gaat. Je harmoniseert processen en werkwijzen, begeleidt verandering met heldere communicatie en zorgt dat mensen aangehaakt blijven. Ondertussen kijk je vooruit: trends in webtechnologie, digital experience en AI vertaal je naar slimme innovatie en duurzame groei.
Wat krijg je?
Een werkplek waarin je kunt groeien, zowel persoonlijk als professioneel. Bovendien profiteer je van alle voordelen van een grote organisatie (hallo pensioenregeling en toffe themaborrels!) én geniet je daarbinnen van de rust van een hecht team. Daarnaast krijg je:
De mogelijkheid tot hybride werken
10% tijd voor eigen professionele ontwikkeling
Mogelijkheid tot leaseauto
25 verlofdagen per jaar
(Internationale) bedrijfsuitjes
Wie ben je?
Jij bent een ervaren leider die strategie en uitvoering moeiteloos combineert. Je stuurt op resultaat, maar net zo goed op vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je communiceert helder, maakt keuzes en krijgt mensen mee, ook bij verandering. Verder:
Heb je minimaal 7 - 10 jaar leidinggevende ervaring
Heb je aantoonbare ervaring met new business en sales
Ben je financieel en analytisch sterk (budgetten, marges, forecasts, businesscases)
Heb je affiniteit met technologie (IT-concepten, agile, digitale trends, digital trust & compliance)
Over Indicia
Wij zijn Indicia, het onafhankelijke digitale bureau uit Tilburg dat sinds 1996 organisaties slimmer maakt op het gebied van bedrijfsvoering, digitale communicatie, marketing en sales. Indicia combineert creativiteit, technologie en ondernemerszin. Zo geven we concrete antwoorden op complexe vraagstukken. Dat doen we met ruim 220 collega’s, met ieder hun eigen talent, expertise en skills.
Over Indicia Betawerk
Indicia Betawerk is een digitale agency gespecialiseerd in hoogwaardige Drupal-oplossingen voor betekenisvolle digitale toepassingen in de publieke sector, de zorg en wetenschap. Vanuit de Brightlands Smart Services Campus in Heerlen werkt ons team van 25 professionals multidisciplinair samen aan strategie, ontwerp, ontwikkeling en doorontwikkeling, altijd gericht op duurzame impact.
Wat zeg je ervan?
Klaar om Betawerk te leiden, te laten groeien én klaar te stomen voor de toekomst? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog hieronder.
Heb je nog vragen? Neem dan contact op met onze recruiter Noa van Ginneken via
noa.van.ginneken@indicia.nl
.

title: Vice President, Client Service Management
description:
Job Description
Vice President, Client Service Management
At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.
Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what  is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Client Service Management to join our Client Services team. This role is located in Amsterdam.
The Account Manager (AM) is responsible for managing a portfolio of Asset Servicing commercial relationships in the EMEA region encompassing all client types. The AM is the senior point of contact for the client and for the team and is accountable for deepening existing relationships through cross-selling, driving relationship profitability and satisfaction.
AM’s understand their client's business fully, serve as an advocate for the relationship within the bank and act as a trusted advisor for their relationships. AMs manage risks, opportunities, and impacts to the bank, and are responsible for leading and coordinating client team members. The AM also oversees the service delivery for our clients and partners with product, operations, credit, Treasury and other BNY functional partners to deliver high quality service.
In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:
Collaborate
Develop a thorough understanding of our client’s business, operating model and technology strategy
Deliver exceptional service aligned to clients’ needs and expectations across BNY’s product and services offering
Act as the central point of escalation across all Operations, Technology and service delivery
Cultivate a deep relationship and appreciation for what drives our clients’ service requirements
Facilitate communication across our clients’ organization (e.g., industry news, regulatory and BNY change, product evolution)
Evolve
Maintain a culture of continuous service improvement across all products and services
Monitor service quality, product performance, and overall client experience with a view to proactively anticipate potential issues and opportunities
Deliver robust operational analytics, insights, and transparency into service performance, leveraging industry leading interfaces
Guide service evolution based on client requirements and changing operating model
Transform
Drive high quality client experience and service, operating model improvements, product innovation, and thought leadership based on client feedback and our in-depth service knowledge and expertise
Provide strategic insight into improvements across service delivery, product, technology, and operations, to create optimal client solutions
Navigate our technology, product, and operations groups to improve service today, and build better solutions for the future
To be successful in this role, you will need to:
The AM has ultimate responsibility and will be held accountable for the overall health and growth of the client relationship.
Identify opportunities to evolve client business for incremental account growth.
Work with external clients to resolve the most complex day-to-day issues and direct them to appropriate resources at BNY.
Lead team members in providing support to clients in addressing and resolving complex operational and technical issues and ensuring requests are executed.
Apply advanced problem-solving skills, judgment, and experience to analyze information and deliver high-quality service to a specialized client base.
Provide key individuals assigned clients with information related to BNY’s products and services across a broad array of lines of business and geographies, leveraging an in-depth understanding of broader BNY services and offerings.
Build strong, collaborative relationships, both internally and externally with our clients
Operate with a sense of urgency, and prioritize effectively
Communicate clearly and concisely and be able to adapt style depending on audience
Apply strong controls focus, and know when to escalate
Demonstrate strong leadership skills and provide guidance to less experienced team members
For This Role We’re Seeking The Following
Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience is required.
6-8 years of total work experience preferred.
Experience in an operational area and/or client services preferred.
Knowledge of common processes governing client arrangements such as Global Custody Agreements, Pricing approaches and client profitability analyses
Proven ability to resolve the most complex or non-routine client issues or inquiries and contribute to business development efforts.
Dutch language proficiency is required.
At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at:
BNY Newsroom
BNY LinkedIn
Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards
America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
“Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025
Our Benefits And Rewards
BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.
BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer - Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

title: Associate Vice President – Product Strategy & President of Nasdaq Investment Firm
description:
Nasdaq is a global technology company serving the capital markets and beyond. We provide market infrastructure, data, analytics, and software that support clients worldwide. As we establish an Investment Firm in the Netherlands, we are seeking a forward‑looking and highly capable leader to serve as the firm’s president, reporting to Vice President - Business Management!
In this role, you’ll lead the establishment, operational build‑out, and ongoing management of the investment firm in Amsterdam. This role carries responsibility for the firm’s governance, strategy execution, regulatory compliance, and high‑quality delivery of services in coordination with Nasdaq’s broader European and global functions. There will be two people with a dotted line into this role.
While the firm will engage in areas such as execution services and related market activities, the focus of this role is broad leadership across business management, regulatory oversight, operational excellence, and future‑ready digital capability development.
Take this opportunity to lead a newly established legal entity of strategic importance within Nasdaq's European ecosystem! This role will combine entrepreneurship with the backing of a global market leader and strong collaboration with high-performing teams across the Nasdaq group.
What You’ll Do
Provide strategic, operational, and cultural leadership for Nasdaq IF, ensuring high standards of integrity, risk management, and performance.
Serve as a day‑to‑day policymaker under Dutch and EU regulatory frameworks, fulfilling “fit and proper” leadership requirements.
Lead all aspects of governance, compliance, and operational controls, working closely with internal legal, risk, and regulatory specialists.
Over time, establish and grow the Amsterdam‑based team, including digital and control‑function capabilities.
Represent the firm with regulators, supervisory authorities, and partners.
Ensure alignment with Nasdaq’s broader business, technology, and infrastructure frameworks.
Partner with leaders across Europe and globally to shape the Investment Firm’s service offering and strategic direction.
What You’ll Bring
Executive experience in financial markets, investment firms, trading venues, or related regulated environments.
Prior exposure to OTC, SI, or similar trading environments
Strong understanding of European regulatory frameworks (MiFID II and relevant Dutch requirements).
Proven track record to work optimally across global teams and influence at senior levels.
Excellent communication skills and comfort operating in a regulated, multinational environment.
Languages: Fluency in English and Dutch.
Nice to Have
Proven track record to lead strategic initiatives, build organizations, and manage sophisticated stakeholder landscapes.
Experience in digital transformation, trading technology, or innovative financial services
Benefits & Rewards
This position will start with 12-month fixed-term contract with the possibility of a permanent contract. The role is located in Amsterdam and offers the opportunity for a hybrid work model. We expect you to be at least 3 days per week in our Amsterdam co-working office space located in Zuidas.
The base pay range is 140,000 - 150,000 EUR gross per annum. Actual pay depends on your skills, experience, education and location.
Does this sound like you?
If you are an accomplished financial‑market leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, regulation, and innovation, we encourage your application.
Please apply via LinkedIn/Nasdaq Career Site or reach out for a confidential conversation with our executive recruitment team at christina.silfwerbrand@nasdaq.com.
Come as You Are
Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, color, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.
