In this fully remote position, you'll work closely with engineering and function as a player-coach: part builder, part decision-maker, zero part facilitator. You'll convert an existing product strategy into actionable sprint-level scope, prototype rapidly using modern AI tooling to eliminate ambiguity, and drive releases that customers can genuinely adopt in actual enterprise environments. If you've shipped net-new enterprise software, leveraged AI as an execution layer (not a press release), and you remain composed when hype meets production realities, you'll have the autonomy to move quickly and the accountability to ensure it holds up. If that sounds like relief rather than pressure, apply.
What You Will Be Doing
Shipped Product Capabilities: Net-new or significantly enhanced product features deployed to production and available to enterprise customers
AI-Driven Prototypes: Functional prototypes built using AI as the core execution layer to validate functionality prior to production hardening
Enterprise-Grade Production Deployments: Fully hardened, secure, reliable releases that satisfy enterprise standards for quality, usability, and security
What You Won’t Be Doing
Portfolio or roadmap-centric product leadership
Reliance on customer discovery as the primary driver of direction
Process-heavy or governance-oriented product roles
Treating AI as an assistant rather than a core execution layer
Vice President Of Products Key Responsibilities
Rapid delivery of enterprise-grade, AI-native product capabilities into customer hands
Basic Requirements
At least 5 years of experience shipping new products or major capabilities end-to-end
Experience owning product delivery from vision refinement through production deployment
Experience prototyping, testing, and iterating products or features using modern AI tooling
Experience ensuring enterprise-software standards for quality, security, reliability, and deployment
About IgniteTech
World-class talent. 100% global remote.
Ready to be a part of the top talent that IgniteTech has curated from thousands of applicants throughout the world? Come join us.
Through our portfolio of leading enterprise software solutions, we ignite business performance for thousands of customers globally. We’re big believers in the remote-work-from-anywhere lifestyle, which creates freedom for our team members and enables us to hire the best and brightest from around the world. A career with IgniteTech is challenging and fast-paced and we’re always looking for energetic and enthusiastic team members.
We’re an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity employer and we value the strength that diversity brings to our workplace.
There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
Working with us
This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. title: Vice President, Customer Success
description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com.
Job Description
ABOUT THE POSITION
The
Vice President, Customer Success
is accountable for ensuring Fluence customers realize the full potential and value of their solutions across the lifecycle – from installation, to post installation adoption through long-term performance, expansion and advocacy. This role drives customer engagement, value realization, and feedback loops that inform the customer of all potential avenues for value realization. Insights may also be used to refine product evolution, services delivery, and go-to-market strategies.
The successful candidate will be heavily focused on customer outcomes working as both a strategic architect and an execution leader to establish quantifiable customer outcomes as a significant contributor to Fluence’s growth flywheel.
Key Responsibilities
Customer Value & Engagement
Engage with customers post-installation to ensure full value realization through effective use cases, best practices, tools, support models, and Fluence resources.
Proactively share Fluence capabilities, fleet-wide insights, and demonstrated value outcomes to reinforce customer confidence and drive utilization.
Support, establish or lead customer forums, user groups, and feedback mechanisms to inform product development, service improvements, and enhanced customer value.
Develop and maintain structured methods to measure customer satisfaction, identify opportunities for greater customer engagement, and provide new use opportunities to the customer.
Serve as a “voice of the customer” for the Chief Customer Success Officer, providing actionable feedback to cross-functional teams to improve customer outcomes.
Customer Success Strategy
Define and execute a global customer success strategy aligned with Fluence’s commercial objectives and long-term growth plans.
Ensure consistent customer success practices and experiences across geographies and offerings.
Drive alignment between customer success initiatives and broader go-to-market, services, and digital strategies.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Manufacturing, Project, Services, and Digital teams to embed key customer outcomes into all stages of the customer lifecycle.
Champion a “One Fluence” approach to customer engagement, ensuring consistency, transparency, and accountability across functions.
Influence prioritization and decision-making through customer insights and performance data.
Performance Management & Continuous Improvement
Define, track, and report on customer success KPIs, including customer satisfaction, adoption metrics, utilization, retention, expansion, and overall value realization.
Lead regular customer and internal business reviews to assess performance and identify improvement opportunities.
Leverage data and insights to continuously refine customer success processes, tools, and operating models.
Qualifications
15+ years of progressive leadership experience in customer success, services, projects, or post-sales functions within energy, renewables, grid infrastructure, or technology-enabled industrial environments.
Proven track record of building and scaling customer focused organizations, driving customer adoption, satisfaction, utilization, retention, and long-term value realization in complex B2B or solution-based businesses.
Strong understanding of project-based delivery models, services lifecycles, and the operational realities of energy storage, power systems, or large-scale infrastructure solutions.
Experience capturing customer success measures and driving value realization, including customer engagement frameworks, outcomes measurement, feedback loops, and continuous improvement mechanisms across geographies.
Ability to translate insights into actionable customer success by working with the customer to draw on the full Fluence capabilities.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related field required.
MBA or advanced degree preferred.
Key Competencies
Customer-centric executive leader with a strong focus on value realization, adoption, and long-term customer outcomes.
Data-driven and outcome-oriented, with experience defining and leveraging KPIs to improve customer satisfaction, retention, and performance.
Strategic thinker with the ability to operationalize customer success at scale in global, matrixed organizations.
Strong cross-functional influence and executive presence, with the ability to align Sales, Services, Product, Digital, and Leadership teams around customer priorities.
Skilled at balancing empathy and advocacy for the customer with internal process discipline and accountability.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and transformation, building structure and clarity as the organization scales.
Our Culture
At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world.
Unleash Voices
We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress.
Customer Fluent
Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate.
Infinite Impact
We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come.
All In
We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success.

title: General Manager For Signage Production and Assembly
description:
Job Description
We are seeking an experienced Signage Production and Assembly General Manager to oversee the planning, fabrication, and installation of the full spectrum of signage projects, from small stickers to highway billboard advertisements. This role requires comprehensive expertise across large-scale architectural and exterior signage as well as interior, regulatory, and wayfinding signage.
Key Responsibilities
Manage end-to-end signage projects, including design coordination, fabrication, logistics, installation, and final handover.
Oversee projects ranging from single large-format signs to full facility signage packages involving hundreds of interior and regulatory signs.
Coordinate with clients, designers, fabricators, installers, and subcontractors to ensure seamless execution.
Lead the production and installation of large-format exterior signage, including pylon and pole signs, monument signs, and building-mounted signage such as channel letters, cabinet signs, and illuminated logos.
Ensure proper structural integrity, permitting, foundation requirements, and safe installation using appropriate equipment and methods.
Oversee interior and compliance-focused signage, including ADA-compliant signage (tactile, braille, contrast, and mounting requirements), wayfinding and directional systems for complex facilities, safety and regulatory signage compliant with OSHA, and fire/exit codes, and interior graphics such as wall murals, window films, and dimensional logos.
Ensure all signage meets applicable accessibility, safety, and regulatory standards.
Ensure consistent quality standards across all signage types and materials.
Verify compliance with ADA, OSHA, fire safety, and local code requirements.
Manage and optimize the use of diverse materials including aluminum, steel, acrylic, vinyl, photopolymer, and specialty films.
Lead and support fabrication and installation teams, ensuring safe work practices and high productivity.
Provide technical guidance and training on best practices, materials, and compliance standards.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in engineering, architecture, industrial design, construction management, or a related field (preferred but not required).
5-10 years of progressive experience in the signage industry, with demonstrated exposure to both large-scale architectural and exterior signage and interior, regulatory, and wayfinding signage systems.
Proven experience managing projects across a wide range of signage types and scales.
Strong working knowledge of ADA signage standards and accessibility requirements, OSHA and fire safety signage regulations, and structural considerations for large-format exterior signs.
Hands-on experience with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, acrylic, vinyl, photopolymer, and specialty films.
Ability to manage fast-paced, multi-project environments with varying timelines and complexity.
Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Resume must be in English.
Must be willing to relocate and work in the Philippines for 2-3 years or more.
Only those who meet the qualifications and have prior experience in signage production and assembly will be considered.

title: Algemeen Directeur bij Beercoo
description:
TwoBirds is de partner van Beercoo bij het vinden van de Algemeen Directeur. Enthousiast? Mail dan uiterlijk zondag 15 maart een originele, enthousiaste reactie + cv naar beercoo@twobirdscompany.com.
De afgelopen jaren hebben broers Vincent & Patrick de Beer Beercoo tot een succesvol schoonmaakbedrijf uitgebouwd waarin mensen écht centraal staan. Met meerdere vestigingen, betrokken teams en duidelijke groeiambities. Persoonlijk contact is hier geen bijzaak, maar de basis. '
Geef een smile, krijg een smile'
is waar hier in wordt geloofd.
Beercoo is dus echt een mensenorganisatie. Met hart voor de zaak, voor klanten én voor elkaar. Daarom zoeken we een
Algemeen Directeur
die fulltime instapt en er met hart en ziel voor gaat. Dit is geen rol op afstand, maar op locatie (Bergschenhoek). Dit is meebouwen. De basis staat stevig. Maar de volgende fase vraagt om iemand die de organisatie verder laat glanzen. Daarom zoekt Beercoo een Algemeen Directeur die helpt om de organisatie verder te professionaliseren zonder dat de cultuur wordt weggepoetst.
Wat ga je doen?
Als Algemeen Directeur:
Ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor de bedrijfsresultaten
Geef je leiding aan het managementteam
Breng je structuur, ritme en KPI-sturing verder op niveau
Vertaal je strategische ambities naar concrete prioriteiten
Verbeter je continu de processen en samenwerking tussen huidige (en toekomstige) vestigingen
Bewaak je cultuur, merkbeloftes en werkplezier
Je bent zichtbaar in de organisatie. Als verbinder van alle afdelingen houdt je overzicht op het grote geheel.
Wat levert jouw werk op?
Je bent succesvol als:
Het MT sterker functioneert als één geheel en in eigenaarschap
De organisatie professioneler en schaalbaarder is ingericht
Strategie zichtbaar wordt in de dagelijkse praktijk
Resultaten verbeteren zonder dat betrokkenheid afneemt
Groei gecontroleerd en gestructureerd wordt gerealiseerd.
Wie ben jij?
Je hebt eerder een eindverantwoordelijke rol in een dienstverlenende organisatie van vergelijkbare omvang (200+ collega’s) gehad
Je hebt eerder leiding gegeven aan managementteams
Je hebt gewerkt in bedrijf dat bestond uit meerdere vestigingen
Ervaring met professionaliseren en schalen van organisaties (bijv. d.m.v. de Scaling Up methodiek is een pré)
Je hebt bewezen ervaring met KPI-sturing en procesverbetering
Ervaring met het operationeel integreren van overgenomen bedrijven en het realiseren van synergie en schaalbaarheid
Ervaring in de hospitality-, facilitaire of schoonmaakervaring is een pré
En daarnaast:
Ben je sterk in helder en inspirerend communiceren
Neem je graag verantwoordelijkheid
Ben je zichtbaar en benaderbaar
En combineer je zakelijkheid met mensgericht leiderschap
Details
Locatie:
Bergschenhoek
Dienstverband:
Fulltime
Startdatum: mei/juni (in overleg)
Procedure
De procedure bestaat uit meerdere gesprekken. Een referentiecheck en assessment maken standaard onderdeel uit van het traject. Wij streven er naar de procedure in mei afgerond te hebben.
TwoBirds is de partner van Beercoo bij het vinden van de Algemeen Directeur Enthousiast? Mail dan uiterlijk zondag 15 maart een originele, enthousiaste reactie + cv naar beercoo@twobirdscompany.com.

title: Head of Social Media and Audiovisual Division - based in Luxembourg
description:
This position is based at our Luxembourg headquarters and requires regular office presence.
The EIB offers you the opportunity to live and work in a truly international and multi-cultural environment. We also offer relocation support. The
EIB
, the European Union's bank, is seeking to recruit for its Secretariat General Directorate, Communication Department, Social Media and Audiovisual Division* at its headquarters in Luxembourg, a
Head of Social Media and Audiovisual Division*
*.
This is a full-time position at grade 7 for which the EIB offers a permanent contract.
new Division following Directorate upcoming reorganisation
internal benchmark Division Head Corporate Communication
Applicants will receive an initial feedback in April 2026.
Assessment Centres for selected applicants would take place by first half of May 2026.
Panel interviews are anticipated for June 2026.
Purpose
The Social Media and Audiovisual Division is a newly created division within the EIB Group’s Communication Department. As Head of the Social Media and Audiovisual Division, you define and steer the strategic direction, corporate standards and governance of the Group’s social media presence and audiovisual output across all platforms, ensuring alignment with institutional priorities, consistency of voice, quality, coherence and impact. You are responsible for ensuring that social and audiovisual content reflects the institution’s values, priorities, and high standards, and supports the visibility of senior leadership.
You oversee the planning, creation, and delivery of compelling, high‑quality social media and audiovisual content ranging from project stories to announcements and event coverage, from short‑form social videos to long‑form video storytelling. You ensure all content is optimised for targeted audience engagement, cross‑channel alignment, and strategic visibility. You identify and test new platforms and features. You plan and deliver paid social campaigns as appropriate. You use AI‑powered tools and data‑driven optimisation techniques to maximise and measure audience reach. You provide direction to a multidisciplinary team of social media strategists and videographers.
This leadership role requires proven social media management and storytelling expertise, editorial and political sensitivity, and the ability to guide in‑house specialists toward excellence in social media and audiovisual output. It requires in-depth experience in building engagement among specific, clearly defined audience groups. It calls for the ability to innovate across formats ranging from rapid‑turnaround social assets to high‑end audiovisual productions. It also demands a strong appetite for exploring, testing, and adopting new tools and technologies, AI‑driven optimisation, and advanced analytics.
Operating Network
You will report to the Director of COM and work in close coordination with other divisions and relevant services involved in digital communication, content production and senior leadership visibility.
The position involves managing a multidisciplinary team, handling a high volume of time sensitive content and navigating a rapidly evolving digital landscape. It requires balancing immediate social media needs with more complex audiovisual productions, while maintaining editorial and political sensitivity.
Accountabilities
Responsibilities
Under the guidance of the Director, and in close cooperation with the Heads of Division in the Communication Department, the Head of the Social Media and Audiovisual Division is responsible for:
Setting the direction for the EIB Group’s social media and audiovisual presence, defining workflows and standards that ensure high‑quality, high‑impact delivery across all channels.
Managing the planning, creation, and production of engaging social and audiovisual content, ensuring it reflects institutional and communication priorities and meets the highest professional standards, safeguarding coherence and consistency.
Prioritising social media and audiovisual activities based on institutional priorities and resource availability, managing demand across the organisation and ensuring focus on high-impact initiatives.
Overseeing and developing a multi-platform approach to audience engagement through social media and video products, with an excellent understanding of formats and styles, and the needs of each platform.
Overseeing and coordinating marketing activities including paid, ensuring targeted and cost-effective use of promotion.
Advising senior leadership on their social media presence.
Leading and developing a multidisciplinary team of social media strategists and videographers, ensuring clarity of roles, strong collaboration, and a culture of continuous improvement.
Driving data-informed decision-making by establishing KPIs and overseeing performance monitoring, social listening and analytics to assess impact, identify trends, risks and opportunities, and generate insights. Ensuring that these insights are used to refine content planning, audience targeting and platform optimisation, and shared across communication colleagues.
Ensuring compliance and risk management, including data protection and reputational safeguards in all social and audiovisual outputs.
Ensuring effective information flow and sharing of practices across the division and with other EIB Group services, fostering coordination and consistency.
Recruiting, developing and managing staff, ensuring the right skills, clear objectives and strong engagement to deliver results.
Creating an environment that empowers staff, encourages collaboration, supports accountability and keeps the team focused on the Group’s priorities.
Qualifications
University degree (minimum an equivalent to a Bachelor) preferably in communication, digital media, journalism, marketing, audiovisual production
At least 10 years of professional experience in social media, digital communication, or audiovisual production in a communication agency or corporate/institutional setting, including managing complex projects with several stakeholders.
Experience or proven ability in managing and coaching staff, ideally in multicultural environments or international organisations (e.g. contribution to: determining team resources and skills; establishing objectives; assessing performance; delegating and supervising tasks; guiding, motivating, coaching and providing feedback).
Proven experience in overseeing design and delivery of high quality audiovisual content, including scripting, filming, editing, livestreaming, and overseeing production workflows.
In‑depth understanding of social media ecosystems, audience behaviour, platform algorithms, and digital content strategies across all major channels.
Strong command of data‑driven audience targeting, analytics, performance optimisation, and evidence‑based decision‑making.
Excellent knowledge of social media publishing tools, monitoring and analytics platforms, and familiarity with AI enhanced content creation, optimisation, and workflow automation.
Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, paid promotion, and amplification strategies.
Familiarity with the EU institutional landscape and an understanding of the EIB Group’s mission, objectives, and operating environment.
Fluency in English both written and spoken. Knowledge of other EU languages would be an advantage.
Competencies

title: Head of Engineering
description:
How You Keep The Engine Running With Us
As Head of Engineering, you are responsible for the development, execution and continuous improvement of all engineering activities for large-scale projects in the VVIP and Special Mission Aircraft (SMA) market. Your scope covers the full lifecycle — from conceptual design through to successful delivery of products and services to the customer.
In addition, the Engineering organization provides modification engineering, engineering services and ongoing support for the Fokker fleet. You lead the Engineering department across Woensdrecht and Hoofddorp, managing approximately 50 engineers and specialists, while ensuring that critical knowledge and expertise in aircraft and systems design is secured and continuously developed.
Position in the Organisation
You report hierarchically to the BU Director CES and lead a team of three Engineering Team Leaders. You act as the primary representative of Engineering within the CES leadership team and towards internal and external stakeholders.
Your Role & Responsibilities
As Head of Engineering, you ensure that engineering teams are fully enabled to execute work packages, projects and services within agreed schedule, budget, quality and technical requirements, while meeting both internal and external customer expectations. You actively shape engineering strategy and provide recommendations to the BU Director regarding process improvements, investments and capability development to maintain market competitiveness.
You manage the implementation of new engineering processes and procedures, including training and employee development programs, and decide on temporary assignment of engineers and outsourcing of defined work packages when required. You support proposal and bid phases and participate in key project, technical and design reviews.
A core responsibility is the development, cross-training and long-term capability growth of engineers and specialists. You challenge resource allocation in terms of volume and expertise to ensure efficient, on-time and high-quality delivery. You provide input to the Operational Plan and are accountable for achieving Engineering-related OP targets.
You represent Engineering in management meetings, strategic sessions, project reviews and design reviews, and ensure that all team members comply with company procedures, safety, quality, environmental, security and export compliance regulations.
Collaboration & Communication
You operate in a highly collaborative environment and work closely with Procurement, Logistics/Operations, Production, Component Maintenance and Commercial teams, including frequent interaction with project sponsors and customers. You consult with Project Managers, Senior Specialists and Compliance Verification Engineers on technical matters and maintain regular alignment with peer managers and the BU Director CES.
How You Are Valuable To Us
You are responsible for reporting on:
Operational Plan targets and KPIs
Budgets, EAC and regular management progress reports
Forward load and capacity planning
Weekly accomplishments and productive hours
Training needs and capability development
Knowledge & Experience Required
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
Proven experience in managing engineering projects and teams
Strong knowledge of change management and process improvement
Demonstrated leadership skills (both hard and soft skills)
Solid background in project management
Proven ability to motivate, empower and develop employees
Knowledge of design organisation requirements, norms, regulations and processes
Familiarity with company regulations related to safety, quality, environment, security and export compliance
Proficiency in English and Dutch (minimum B2 level)
Where you will be working
With over a century of experience, innovation, knowledge, and expertise flow through our veins. Our cross-departmental approach and customized solutions leave a mark on the future of aerospace innovation. With our warm culture, we are more than just colleagues; we are a team of friends dedicated to both enjoyment and development. This passion and continuous improvement are what make our employees commit to Fokker Services Group for the long term.
We are pioneers with courage. It's no coincidence that we are a global player in aircraft maintenance and development. With passionate colleagues, we work on the most innovative and advanced solutions to make the aerospace sector more sustainable and efficient. We continue to push the boundaries of what is possible, ensuring that aircraft remain where they belong: in the sky!
What We Offer
A competitive salary commensurate with your knowledge and experience;
27-29 holiday days and 13 ADV leave days per year (when working full-time, 40 hours);
A challenging international working environment;
Professional and personal growth opportunities and a lot of autonomy;
Company laptop and phone;
An insider's look into the innovative world of aviation;
A lot of room for professional and personal growth;
Fun colleagues (trust us, we're not biased).

title: Regional Sales Director, Benelux
description:
Are you ready to power the World's connections?
If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.
About The Role
Kong is seeking a Enterprise Sales Leader to help us build and grow the Kong API platform and our Enterprise Sales Team in the Netherlands for Benelux. We are searching for a seasoned industry leader who will lead our Enterprise Account Executives and drive business results and revenue. title: Key Account Director
location: Son en Breugel, North Brabant, Netherlands
description:
Director of Key Accounts Benelux at Rubix
Requirements
Over 12 years of experience
In B2B key account management for large industrial or technical customers
Clear track record in new business development, especially developing and winning sizable key accounts
Experienced people leader
Excels at stakeholder management in an international matrix organization
Fluent in Dutch and English
Rubix is Europe’s leading industrial maintenance, repair, and overhaul distributor, keeping production lines running for 220,000 customers worldwide. The Director of Key Accounts sets a focused course for the 80 Benelux key accounts, concentrating the team’s time on growth of critical customers and shaping a more proactive approach to winning new business.
About Rubix
Across Europe, industrial manufacturers turn to Rubix for the maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) solutions that keep their plants running. The company combines a pan-European distribution network – supplying everything from bearings and power transmission to fluid power, machining tools, PPE, and general maintenance products – with the expertise of its technical competence centers. These teams design and deliver value-added services such as automation and robotization projects, on-site engineering support, and condition monitoring to cut downtime and waste. Together with customers, Rubix rethinks total cost of ownership (TCO) by consolidating suppliers, committing to measurable cost savings, and integrating digitally with customer systems. In the Benelux, Rubix has built long-term partnerships with major players in, among other sectors, food and beverage, pharma, recycling, and packaging.
In 2017, private equity firm Advent International brought together two major European distributors, Brammer and IPH, into a single platform business. Since then, Rubix has executed more than seventy acquisitions, building a multi-specialist network and strengthening its position in a highly fragmented market. In 2024, the group generated more than three billion euros in revenue with strong profitability. The company’s focus remains on cementing its position as Europe’s leading MRO provider through further organic and acquisitive growth, using its scale, service offering, and TCO-driven approach to win market share.
Today, more than 8,500 skilled employees work at Rubix in Europe’s major industrial regions. Teams combine local customer knowledge with the scale and expertise of a pan-European group, supported by growing digital channels and an integrated logistics network. This includes a modern distribution center in Venlo serving the Benelux. Employees at Rubix do as promised, take ownership when something needs fixing, and work with customers, suppliers, and colleagues to find better solutions every day. Together they build a business that transforms how industrial products and services are delivered across Europe.
Vacancy: Director of Key Accounts Benelux
In the Benelux, key accounts are Rubix’ growth engine in the fragmented MRO market. The Director of Key Accounts drives the commercial agenda for these customers in the Benelux, setting clear priorities and shifting the team’s time towards accounts and initiatives with the highest impact on Rubix’s growth. This includes a shift towards significantly more business development, where the Director of Key Accounts builds a more proactive, structured approach and develops the team’s capabilities to create and convert new opportunities. At the same time, the Director ensures the key account managers deliver on their commitments to existing customers and increase share of wallet through cross-selling, gradually moving towards a healthy balance between managing the current base and developing new business.
Impact through close collaboration with the Rubix network
To deliver this growth, the Director of Key Accounts works through a matrix rather than standalone. Key account business runs through the branch network, while valueadded services and projects sit with the technical centers in the Product & Services organization. The Director brings these perspectives together in shared account plans: aligning branch and network managers on pricing, service levels and focus, working with technical specialists to shape solutions that drive cost savings, and partnering with the European key account organization on pan-European contracts. Their success is measured not only in revenue and margin, but also in signed-off cost savings and crosssell projects with the technical centers. That makes it essential for the Director of Key Accounts to balance competing P&Ls and priorities and still secure the right support for their key accounts.
Within this matrix, the Director of Key Accounts Benelux works closely with leaders at all levels in the Rubix organization. They partner with the Chief Commercial Officer and network sales directors who run the Benelux branch network, with the COO responsible for operations and the Venlo distribution center, and with the Director Product & Services who steers the technical centers.
“Growth here isn’t a slide deck. It’s new contracts with key accounts, signed-off cost savings, and our customers’ factories that run better because our branches and specialists pulled together. The Director of Key Accounts Benelux is someone who enjoys achieving that kind of tangible result – and the collaborations and trade-offs required to get there.”
– Paul van der Rest, CEO Benelux & Nordics
The Director of Key Accounts reports to the CEO Benelux & Nordics and is part of the Benelux leadership team, with a dotted reporting line to the VP European Key Accounts. They lead a team of five key account managers in the Netherlands and two in Belgium. They also have line responsibility for Magema, a specialized business unit focused on large infrastructure and semi-public key accounts. A dedicated Business Unit Director runs Magema day to day and reports into the Director of Key Accounts, who ensures that its plans and performance are fully integrated into the broader Benelux key account agenda.
Across this team, the Director raises the bar on commercial discipline: coaching different profiles of key account managers, tightening basic reporting and pipeline management, and using these insights to keep everyone focused on the right customers, business development opportunities, and projects. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced leader who moves easily between senior procurement discussions and coaching a diverse team. Transparent and steady, they have clear conversations about margin, cost savings, and priorities to steer the business in a performance-driven, PE-backed environment. The Director of Key Accounts is able to align branches, technical centers, and European colleagues behind a shared plan and creates visible impact on Rubix’ growth and on major Benelux industrial players as a result.
Interested?
Rubix is working with Top of Minds to fill this vacancy.

title: Sales Associate Director - Government sector, Wolters Kluwer Health

description:

.

Sales cycle efficiency

title: Head of Finance  – Buy & Build organisatie - Leidende en snelgroeiende speler in Europa.
description:
Een internationale distributeur van motorfietsonderdelen is één van de leidende en snelst groeiende spelers in Europa. Sinds de start van een buy-and-build strategie in 2017 is de organisatie door 16 aanvullende overnames gegroeid tot een onderneming met circa €170 miljoen omzet.
De organisatie bestaat uit twee business units: Aftermarket B2B en Original Equipment / Vintage (OE). De business unit OE richt zich op onderdelen voor motorfietsen ouder dan 15 jaar en neemt daarmee een unieke positie in de markt in, met zowel B2B- als B2C-afzetkanalen. Deze unit bestaat uit meerdere gespecialiseerde bedrijven die gezamenlijk klanten bedienen in meer dan 100 landen wereldwijd.
De komende jaren staan in het teken van verdere professionalisering en internationale groei, waarbij jij als Head of Finance een belangrijke rol speelt.
In het kort:
Sparring partner MD, P&L verantwoordelijk voor BU OE NL, P&C cyclus, rapportage, business reviews binnen brede span of control Finance en HR
Samen met het team managen van end-to-end financiële processen incl. externe rapportage, fiscale verplichting en begeleiding audit
Diverse projecten: procesoptimalisaties, automatiseringen trajecten, strategische business cases en uitrol van nieuwe investeringen
Stakeholders: Group CFO, Managing Director, Sales Lead, Operations Manager, Finance Team (+/-4) en overige interne business stakeholders
Als Head of Finance ben jij eindverantwoordelijk voor de financiële sturing van een organisatie met een omzet van ca. €40 miljoen. Je rapporteert aan de Group CFO en bent een sparringpartner voor de Managing Director van de OE business. Samen zorg je voor alignment tussen lokale en groep brede doelstellingen, rapportages en financiële processen. Waar de Managing Director een zeer commerciële focus heeft, zal jij intern een bredere verantwoordelijkheid dragen voor Finance, HR en Legal. Je werkt intensief samen met andere afdelingen zoals Sales, Operations en IT, en bent aanspreekpunt voor externe stakeholders zoals de Accountant, de belastingdienst, verzekeraars en leveranciers.
In deze rol ben je zowel verantwoordelijk voor de financiële administratie en rapportages van de Nederlandse entiteiten, jaarrekeningen en fiscale verplichtingen maar ook voor de gehele planning & control cyclus en periodieke management rapportage (KPI’s, analyses). Je stuurt actief op margeoptimalisatie, groei, risico’s en verbeterinitiatieven. Daarnaast draag je bij aan het realiseren van een schaalbare organisatie door procesoptimalisatie, harmonisatie en automatisering. Je werkt mee aan strategische business cases en uitrol van nieuwe proposities en investeringen.
Goed om te weten
Je werkt met een klein, toegewijd team en speelt een sleutelrol in de verdere opbouw en professionalisering ervan. Door de ontwikkeling van de organisatie krijg je de ruimte om het team uit te breiden en mede vorm te geven aan de toekomstige finance organisatie. Kortom: een rol met impact, waar jij het financiële fundament versterkt en meebouwt aan de toekomst van een internationale groep in de motorsportbranche.
Wie ben jij?
Wij op zoek naar een scherpe, energieke en bovenal pragmatische Head of Finance. Iemand die snel de essentie ziet, knopen durft door te hakken en dit door weet te vertalen naar concrete acties. In deze rol voel je je thuis in een organisatie die ondernemerschap ademt en weet je moeiteloos te schakelen met teams op elk niveau.
"Wij combineren een hands-on mentaliteit met een scherpe helikopterview – altijd dicht op de business, zonder het grotere plaatje uit het oog te verliezen. De combinatie van Private Equity met ondernemerschap zorgt voor focus, tempo en resultaat. Tegelijkertijd blijven we trouw aan onze nuchtere roots: geen ego’s, maar doen wat werkt. Wij ademen betrokkenheid en delen we een diepe passie voor het product."
Bachelor of Master in Finance, (Bedrijfs)economie of Accountancy, eventueel aangevuld met een post-masteropleiding (RA, RC)
8 jaar+ relevante werkervaring als Finance Manager, (sr) Financial Controller of Business Controller;
Je hebt een sterke financieel technische basis (Dutch GAAP, IC, fiscaliteit) en Inzicht in hoe een boekhouding hoort te functioneren; ‘knows what good looks like’;
Ervaring in distributie/handel/logistiek/E-commerce is een pré;
Communicatief sterk; in staat om te schakelen en communicatie af te stemmen op diversiteit aan gesprekspartners in een Private Equity / ondernemende MKB omgeving;
Ervaring met (optimaliseren/implementeren van) diverse systemen .
Mensgericht – in staat om een team in hun kracht te zetten en oog voor persoonlijke en inhoudelijke ontwikkeling
Pragmatisch, integer en met een positieve, ondernemende instelling
Meer weten?

Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden
Vanaf 2025 ontvangen defensiemedewerkers voortaan het vakantiegeld en de eindejaarsuitkering niet meer als afzonderlijke uitkeringen, maar bouwen ze dit maandelijks op via het Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB). Het IKB voor defensiemedewerkers bedraagt in totaal 16,33 procent van het salaris. Met het IKB kunnen defensiemedewerkers zelf beslissen wanneer, waaraan en hoeveel budget zij besteden aan tijd, geld of fiscale faciliteiten. Dit kan tot maximaal het maandelijks opgebouwde budget. Het IKB kan gebruikt worden voor:
Maximaal 15 procent van het salaris kan maandelijks worden benut voor de uitruil van de tegemoetkoming woon-werkverkeer.
Het maandelijkse verschil tussen de tegemoetkoming in de kosten van eigen vervoer voor woon-werkverkeer en het fiscaal maximum.
Een fiets voor persoonlijk gebruik, inclusief fietsaccessoires en een fietsverzekering.
Een computer die ook te gebruiken is voor werk of studie, inclusief computeraccessoires en een computerverzekering.
Een accu of elektrische onderdelen voor een fiets.
De betaling van de vakbondscontributie laten uitbetalen.
Defensie verwacht de mogelijkheden van het IKB in de toekomst verder uit te breiden.
Bijzonderheden
Wij zijn wereldwijd inzetbaar voor vrede en veiligheid. Een diversiteit in denkwijzen, perspectieven en kwaliteiten draagt bij aan het behalen van onze missie: “Beschermen wat ons dierbaar is.” Hiervoor zijn we nadrukkelijk op zoek naar nieuwe collega’s die bijdragen aan de diversiteit binnen Defensie.
Defensie zet zich ook in om medewerkers in dienst te nemen die onder de doelgroep van de Wet banenafspraak vallen. Sta jij geregistreerd in het doelgroepenregister, dan nodigen we ook jou uit om te reageren!
Je sollicitatiebescheiden worden uiterlijk drie maanden na afronding van de selectieprocedure vernietigd. Deze termijn is langer dan de standaard-termijn die de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming voorschrijft. Deze langere termijn is nodig voor het geval er door een interne kandidaat een bezwaar- en/of beroepsprocedure wordt gestart.
Conform de interne procedures worden als eerste medewerkers met een dienstverband bij het ministerie van Defensie in beschouwing genomen. Wanneer blijkt dat er geen geschikte interne kandidaat geselecteerd kan worden, worden externe belangstellenden in beschouwing genomen.
Meer over de functiegroep
Organisatienaam
Ministerie van Defensie
Organisatieomschrijving
Defensie zet zich in voor de belangen, welvaart en vrijheid van Nederland. We zijn dagelijks actief in binnen- en buitenland. Onze wereldwijde inzet versterkt de internationale samenwerking en zorgt ervoor dat mensen zich in vrijheid kunnen ontplooien. Nu en in de toekomst.
Bij het ministerie van Defensie werken ongeveer 79 duizend mensen direct en indirect aan vrede en veiligheid. Het ministerie bestaat uit het Commando Materieel & IT (COMMIT), de Bestuursstaf (het departement), de Koninklijke Marine, de Koninklijke Landmacht, de Koninklijke Luchtmacht, de Koninklijke Marechaussee, het Defensie Ondersteuningscommando (DOSCO).
Defensie is een van de grootste werkgevers van Nederland en vertoont overeenkomsten met een groot bedrijf. De operationele commando's (zee-, land- en luchtstrijdkrachten), de Marechaussee, het DOSCO en de COMMIT lijken op werkmaatschappijen.
De krijgsmacht beschermt wat ons dierbaar is. Het Defensie Ondersteuningscommando (DOSCO) levert daar een essentiële bijdrage aan. Met meer dan 10.000 medewerkers ondersteunen wij de landmacht, luchtmacht, marine en marechaussee altijd en overal. Dit doen wij op defensielocaties, tijdens dagelijkse werkzaamheden, op oefening en tijdens inzet. Wij zorgen ervoor dat de krijgsmacht een voorsprong heeft in het gevecht!
Bij DOSCO draag je bij aan een sterke Defensieorganisatie. Wij zijn een de veelzijdigste onderdelen van Defensie. Van catering tot bewaking, van vastgoed tot logistiek, van facilitair tot inkoop, van HR tot medische zorg, achter elke militair schuilt een team van vakmensen die 24 uur per dag ondersteuning bieden. Je hoeft overigens geen militair te zijn om bij DOSCO te werken. Bij DOSCO draait het om vakmanschap, betrouwbaarheid en verbondenheid.
Spreekt dit jou aan en sluit de vacature aan op jouw profiel? Solliciteer dan snel!
Organisatie-URL
www.defensie.nl
Afdelingsnaam
Defensie Ondersteuningscommando
Afdelingsomschrijving
De werkzaamheden worden verricht binnen de Divisie Personeel & Organisatie Defensie (DPOD) ressorterend onder het Defensie Ondersteuningscommando (DOSCO).
De DPOD is één van de divisies van het DOSCO. De DPOD bestaat uit zeven dienstencentra en de MD-groep.
De DPOD ondersteunt de defensieonderdelen met P&O-dienstverlening. Zij biedt daartoe kennis aan over het P&O-functiegebied en verleent diensten aan leidinggevenden, P&O-functionarissen en defensiewerknemers binnen het gehele spectrum van de personele dienstverlening. Hiermee draagt DPOD bij aan de personele gereed stelling van Defensie en het uitvoeren van goed werkgeverschap. De operationele commando’s (OPCO’s) kunnen zich hierdoor maximaal richten op de uitvoering van de primaire taakstelling van Defensie.
Bij de DPOD is de menselijke component cruciaal. Werkgeluk, heldere onderlinge afspraken over waar en wanneer je werkt, activiteit gericht, met blijvende aandacht voor onze afnemers en de te leveren producten en diensten zijn daarbij leidende principes. De Management Development groep (MD Groep) heeft tot doel het uitvoering geven aan het geheel van activiteiten dat gericht is op het opsporen, selecteren, ontwikkelen en begeleiden van de meest getalenteerde functionarissen van Defensie voor het vervullen van de hoogste managementfuncties binnen Defensie, ten behoeve van het optimaal functioneren van de Defensieorganisatie. Daarnaast begeleidt de MD Groep het Management Development-Trainingsprogramma en Professional Development-Trainingsprogramma. De MD Groep bestaat uit 19 medewerkers, verdeeld over het cluster MD Militairen, het cluster MD Burgerpersoneel en het cluster MD Ondersteuning.

title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO/Founder)
description:
We are hiring on behalf of a leading global AI player.
Founder Research Consultant (Short-Term / Private Engagement)
The Mission
We are inviting
Founders and Early Operators
to help us document and review data systems they’ve built or managed at mid-size startups (
20–150 people
). We want to analyze the architecture behind:
Core BI Layers:
Dashboards, metrics, cohorts, and funnels.
Operational Reporting:
30+ key queries across Product, Ops, and Finance.
Stakeholder Logic:
How data flows from schema to decision-maker.
Who This Is For
Experienced Founders:
You have built or managed non-trivial internal systems in high-growth environments.
Startup Veterans:
Prior experience in a high-growth startup environment (20–150 people) is required.
Domain Agnostic:
We value architectural complexity over specific industry experience.
Availability:
You can commit to a short-term, clearly scoped research engagement.
Engagement Details
Scope:
Retrospective documentation and technical review of previously built systems.
Privacy:
This is a private research effort. Full technical specs and compensation will be shared after an initial screening.
NOTICE:
We will only be hiring CEOs, Founders, and Ex-Founders
We consider all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics and provide reasonable accommodations upon request.
Contract and Payment Terms
You will be engaged as an independent contractor.
This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.
Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.
Your work will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.
Payments are weekly on Stripe or Wise based on services rendered.
Please note: We are unable to support H1-B or STEM OPT candidates at this time.

title: Regional General Manager
description:
Regional General Manager (Multisite – Sales & Operations)
Location: Amsterdam or Rotterdam
Salary: Around €120,000 gross per annum + bonus
A leading
multisite, customer-facing services business
is seeking a
Regional General Manager
to take full ownership of a regional portfolio across the Netherlands. This role carries
end-to-end accountability
for commercial growth, operational performance, customer experience, and financial results.
The position combines
strong outbound sales leadership
with hands-on operational management. Approximately
half of the role is commercially focused
, driving new business acquisition and field sales performance, while maintaining close oversight of service delivery, team execution, and customer retention across multiple locations.
This role requires a leader who is highly visible in the field, capable of driving performance from day one, and comfortable operating in environments with
fast sales cycles alongside more complex commercial agreements
.
Key Responsibilities
Commercial & Sales Leadership
Drive regional revenue growth through hands-on business development and outbound sales leadership.
Lead and develop field-based sales leaders, ensuring strong pipeline management and target accountability.
Close fast-cycle transactions and oversee larger, more complex deals.
Maintain consistent sales momentum through active forecasting, reviews, and client engagement.
Operations & Customer Experience

title: Algemeen directeur
description:
Om onze ambities – meer natuur en biodiversiteit – waar te maken zoekt Vereniging Natuurmonumenten een Algemeen Directeur die verbinding brengt, visie toont en onze organisatie op inspirerende wijze vertegenwoordigt.
Vereniging Natuurmonumenten
Natuurmonumenten is de grootste onafhankelijke natuurorganisatie van Nederland met een achterban van bijna een miljoen mensen, ruim 7.500 vrijwilligers en zo’n 800 medewerkers. Natuurmonumenten zet zich in voor alle natuur in Nederland. We maken ons sterk voor het herstel van de biodiversiteit, overal in het land. Sinds onze oprichting in 1905 zijn we als vereniging eigenaar en beheerder van natuurgebieden en cultureel erfgoed. Maar zijn we ook de stem van de natuur. Bekijk hier Onze visie | Natuurmonumenten en het Jaarverslag Natuurmonumenten 2024.
Natuurmonumenten is een vereniging met een sterke democratische structuur. De ledenraad vertegenwoordigt de leden en fungeert als hoogste orgaan binnen de vereniging. Zij benoemt het bestuur, stelt het jaarverslag vast en bespreekt belangrijke beleidslijnen. Het bestuur heeft de algemene leiding en bestuurt op hoofdlijnen, terwijl de werkorganisatie binnen kaders opereert onder leiding van de directie.
De rol van Algemeen Directeur
Als Algemeen Directeur maak je onderdeel uit van een collegiale driekoppige directie. Samen met de Directeur Natuur en de Directeur Financiën & Bedrijfsvoering voer je de strategische en operationele leiding over de werkorganisatie en vertegenwoordig je de vereniging extern. De Algemeen Directeur is primair verantwoordelijk voor het functioneren van de organisatie als geheel en is tegelijkertijd het gezicht van Natuurmomenten en de Nederlandse natuur richting maatschappij, overheid en partners.
De directie besluit collectief en unaniem over strategische thema’s, externe positionering, werkgeverschap, mandateringsregelingen, sociaal beleid, personele besluitvorming op MT‑niveau en overige organisatie brede vraagstukken. Daarnaast is de directie verantwoordelijk voor effectieve en efficiënte bedrijfsvoering, een gezonde organisatiecultuur, prettige werksfeer en het bewaken van het besturingsmodel.
De Algemeen Directeur is voorzitter van het Managementteam, dat naast de directie bestaat uit twee Landsdeelmanagers, een HR Manager en een Manager Marketing & Communicatie. Het MT zorgt voor integrale beleidsontwikkeling en het realiseren van de doelstellingen van Natuurmonumenten, met gedeelde verantwoordelijkheid voor transparante besluitvorming en organisatiebrede afstemming. In deze bestuurlijke context vervult de Algemeen Directeur een sleutelrol: verbindend leider, bewaker van governance, strategisch boegbeeld en drijvende kracht achter een toekomstbestendige organisatie.
Als Algemeen Directeur ben jij de verbindende kracht binnen de werkorganisatie en zet je mensen in hun kracht. Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor bestuur, ledenraad en externe partners. Je zit de directie voor en zorgt voor gezamenlijke, gedragen besluitvorming. Je bewaakt de integrale koers, versterkt de organisatiecultuur en zorgt dat medewerkers — verspreid over het hele land — hun werk met trots en plezier kunnen doen.
Je begrijpt de unieke dynamiek van een vereniging, waar leden, vrijwilligers, medewerkers, bestuur en ledenraad samen het hart vormen. Je beweegt je soepel in deze omgeving, laat verschillende stemmen meewegen en houdt tegelijkertijd helder zicht op de lange lijn: natuurherstel, biodiversiteit, maatschappelijke relevantie en een duurzame toekomst voor onze natuur. Je ziet en benut kansen voor natuurbescherming door bruggen te slaan tussen publiek, privaat en de eigen organisatie; je treedt inspirerend en verbindend op naar interne en externe stakeholders.
Dit ga je doen:
1. Koers en strategie
Je vertaalt de missie van Natuurmonumenten naar duidelijke keuzes en heldere strategische richting.
Je zorgt voor samenhang en voortgang in de uitvoering van de meerjarenstrategie.
2. Leiderschap en organisatie
Je geeft leiding aan het Managementteam en stimuleert samenwerking over afdelingen en regio’s heen.
Je bouwt aan een inclusieve, veilige en open cultuur waarin medewerkers kunnen groeien en zich gehoord voelen.
Je versterkt de professionaliteit van de organisatie en ondersteunt teams om hun impact te vergroten.
3. Maatschappelijke positie en samenwerking
Je vertegenwoordigt Natuurmonumenten in gesprekken met overheden, belangenorganisaties, maatschappelijke partners en andere natuurorganisaties.
Je zoekt actief verbinding met partijen die bijdragen aan natuurinclusieve oplossingen.
Je communiceert helder, authentiek en met impact over de betekenis van natuur in de samenleving.
4. Werkgeversrol en medezeggenschap
Je onderhoudt een open, respectvolle samenwerking met de OR.
Je stuurt op arbeidsvoorwaarden, formatie, sociaal beleid en een gezonde werkbalans.
Je zorgt voor een organisatie waar medewerkers graag werken en zich blijven ontwikkelen.
Wat jij meeneemt
Onze ideale kandidaat heeft:
Sterke affiniteit met de doelen van Natuurmonumenten; je bent intrinsiek gemotiveerd om de natuur in Nederland te beschermen.
Een natuurlijke gave om mensen te motiveren en te verbinden.
Generalistische en ruime managementervaring; je hebt een MT aangestuurd en gevoel voor het werken in een collegiaal directieteam.
Sterke politiek-bestuurlijke ervaring, zowel nationaal als provinciaal, en vaardigheid in het met gezag en impact behartigen van belangen van Natuurmonumenten in het publieke domein, zowel aan de bestuurstafel als in de media.
Ervaring met verandermanagement; je kunt zowel intern als extern positieve beweging brengen en zichtbare impact brengen op organisatieontwikkeling.
Oog voor het belang van fondsenwerving, om de organisatie op lange termijn financieel gezond en optimaal impactvol te houden.
De volgende strategische competenties zijn essentieel om deze functie te kunnen uitoefenen:
Organisatiesensitiviteit
: Je voelt feilloos aan wat er leeft in de organisatie, sluit gemakkelijk aan bij collega’s op alle niveaus en verbindt perspectieven op een natuurlijke manier. Je waardeert het verenigingskarakter en betrekt leden, vrijwilligers en medewerkers waar het ertoe doet. Je zoekt zowel intern als extern de verbinding op.
Besluitvaardigheid
: Je neemt tijdig en helder besluiten, ook als het spannend is of belangen uiteenlopen. Je doet dat zorgvuldig, onderbouwd en transparant.
Visie
: Je bent een visionair, denkt ook buiten bestaande kaders en hebt durf. Je brengt een toekomstgerichte blik op natuur, samenleving en organisatieontwikkeling. Je kunt complexe maatschappelijke vraagstukken vertalen naar een inspirerende koers.
Groepsgericht leidinggeven:
Je stuurt resultaatgericht en inhoudelijk op hoofdlijnen. Je creëert een veilige omgeving waarin teams samenwerken, elkaar versterken en vanuit vertrouwen verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Je delegeert, stimuleert open communicatie, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.
Optreden
: Je staat stevig, communiceert helder en authentiek en vertegenwoordigt Natuurmonumenten op een manier die vertrouwen wekt — zowel intern als extern. Je weet natuur, beleid en bestuur op een toegankelijke manier te verbinden.
Wat wij bieden
Een betekenisvolle leiderschapsrol met impact op de toekomst van de Nederlandse natuur.
Een professionele organisatie met bevlogen medewerkers en vrijwilligers.
Een collegiale directie en een betrokken bestuur en ledenraad.
Arbeidsvoorwaarden conform de Regeling beloning directeuren van goede‑doelenorganisaties.
Een inspirerende werkplek op ons centraal kantoor in Amersfoort naast het centraal station. Daarnaast heb je meer dan 24 prachtige werkplekken verspreid door het land.
Meer informatie en solliciteren

uiterlijk 29 maart 2026
je cv en motivatiebrief in door te klikken op de solliciteren button. Via de website van Natuurmonumenten kun je dan je sollicitatie indienen.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
Engineering Director | Sun Test Systems B.V.
We design and manufacture high-precision test equipment for fixed-wing aircraft and helicopters. Our systems are trusted by aviation customers worldwide — in an industry where there is simply no room for compromise on reliability, innovation or quality.
As we enter our next phase of growth, we’re looking for an Engineering Director to lead the charge: someone who bridges deep technical expertise with strategic vision and strong people leadership.
The Opportunity
This is a senior leadership role with real weight behind it. As Engineering Director, you will own the engineering organization end-to-end — setting direction, driving transformation and ensuring the function is built to scale.
Your mandate is clear: evolve a technically excellent team into a strategic, future-ready engineering organization — one where project management, innovation, efficiency and digitalization are embedded in how work gets done.
You will sit on the leadership team and report directly to the Managing Director.
What You’ll Be Doing
Strategic Leadership
Define and execute an engineering strategy tightly aligned with the company’s broader business goals
Turn emerging trends — AI, smart manufacturing, digital twins — into a concrete, actionable technology roadmap
Drive closer collaboration across engineering, production, sales and service
Organizational Transformation
Restructure and professionalize the engineering department for scale
Introduce standardized processes, modular design principles and repeatable ways of working
Strengthen resource planning, technical governance and accountability
Build a culture of ownership within the engineering team
Delivery & Business Impact
Own budgets, margins and project timelines
Identify and act on opportunities to improve engineering efficiency and reduce cost
Lead risk management across complex, high-stakes technical projects
What We’re Looking For
Experience & Background
Degree-educated in mechanical engineering, hydraulics, electrical engineering, mechatronics or a related discipline
10+ years in a high-tech, engineering-driven environment
A proven track record of leading and transforming engineering organizations
Solid understanding of AI applications in engineering or manufacturing contexts
Experience with smart manufacturing, digitalization and process improvement
A background in aviation or another regulated industry is a strong advantage
Familiarity with digital twin engineering is a plus
Knowledge of additive manufacturing technologies is a plus
Who You Are
An inspiring leader who knows how to bring people with you through change
Someone who challenges the status quo and isn’t afraid to make bold calls
Decisive, yet skilled at building alignment and consensus
A strategic thinker who rolls up their sleeves and gets things done
Candidates must be based in The Netherlands
What’s On Offer
A pivotal leadership role in a growing, ambitious high-tech company
Real influence over the company’s technology direction and future
The autonomy to shape the engineering organization the way you believe it should be built
A salary of €9,000–€10,000 per month, plus a competitive benefits package
Interested?
Ready to lead the transformation of an engineering organization into an AI-driven, high-tech powerhouse? Send your CV and a brief cover letter to
carol.vanmuijen@suntestsystems.nl
, or reach out directly for a confidential conversation. We’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Associate / Vice President - Financial Sponsor Coverage Group
description:
Business Unit:
Financial Sponsor Coverage Group
Industry:
No Industry
Overview
Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.
Financial Sponsor Coverage Group
Houlihan Lokey’s Financial Sponsor Coverage Group (FSCG) is made up of more than 35 professionals, spread across the globe. In Europe, FSCG operates across regions, with currently 7 Managing Directors and 3 Directors. The Group manages approximately 1,900 relationships, mostly private equity firms, infrastructure funds, credit funds, family offices, and sovereign wealth funds.
Following several successful acquisitions, Europe continues to be a central point of HL’s committed growth strategy. With the strength of our deal teams and sector teams, the Financial Sponsor Coverage Group is looking to expand accordingly to enable us to deepen our coverage and expertise across strategic locations in the European market. In 2025, Houlihan Lokey was named ‘European Private Equity Financial Advisor of the Year’ at the Mergermarket M&A Awards. As such, we are pleased to continue hiring also for FSCG, and there has never been a more exciting time to join this team.
The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Associate or Vice President to be a part of our Financial Sponsor Coverage effort in Amsterdam. This individual will play a vital role in further developing our relationships with Benelux, Nordic and European private equity funds in close partnership with the local bankers, acting as a key point of contact and orchestrating the full range of Houlihan Lokey's services.
The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting, developing and maintaining a strong network of relationships within the private equity community in the Benelux & Nordic regions. They will support our Managing Directors in identifying and generating transaction opportunities, leveraging the deep expertise of our industry and product teams.
Key Responsibilities
Support origination efforts across the Benelux & Nordic regions, and internationally
Develop dialogues with key private equity funds in the Benelux & Nordic market, establishing trusted relationships with investment teams across all levels
Act as a strategic advisor to sponsor clients on complex M&A, financing, capital structure, and other topics
Support European MDs to generate a flow of relevant and customized investment ideas for sponsor clients, drawing on the bank's sector expertise
Collaborate closely with Houlihan Lokey's product (i.e. Capital Solutions such as debt financing, primary capital raisings etc.) and sector bankers across Europe to ensure the delivery of an integrated, high-quality service
Embody and promote a culture of collaboration, high performance, and integrity
Experience And Qualifications
Strong background in Corporate Finance, primarily gained in Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) or Leveraged Finance
4-7 years of experience, operating as an Associate or Vice President currently at an investment bank, a leading M&A boutique, or within a financing team
A structured and rigorous approach to origination and business development
Strong work ethic, organizational skills and ability to multitask
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
Ability to grow our business and act entrepreneurially
Strong analytical abilities
Maturity and presence to interact effectively with private equity funds and HL stakeholders
A high-impact, low-ego personality with a natural talent for collaboration
Ability to integrate smoothly into Houlihan Lokey's culture, characterized by collaboration, entrepreneurship, and excellence
Fluency in Dutch and English language. Swedish language is also advantageous.
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Vice President, Marketing
description:
About FareHarbor
At FareHarbor, our mission is to make experiences better for everyone. Founded in 2013 in Hawaii and acquired by Booking Holdings in 2018, FareHarbor creates powerful tools that enable our clients (think boat rentals, museums, food tours, events and more!) to operate and grow.
With over 20,000 clients across 90+ countries—we’re the largest in our industry and shaping the future of travel, together.
Our team is an ‘Ohana of 700+ people around the world. We’re passionate about pioneering an industry, embracing challenges with open arms, and delivering value to the experiences industry.
FareHarbor Core Values
Think Client First
We Are One ‘Ohana
Be Curious and Learn
Own It.
Act With Integrity
Embrace the Challenge
Why FareHarbor?
Founding FareHarbor required unwavering passion. Turning a start-up into the world’s leading and largest reservation software for tours, activities, and attractions required relentless dedication and vision. To date, we’ve helped over 20,000 global businesses operate successfully and are proud to have played a role in enabling business owners to live their dreams.
And since day one, we’ve known that our real success lies in our people—the Ohana.
With each new feature launched and new client onboarded, there is a team of incredible people behind the scenes who are full of dedication, passion, energy, and the will to succeed. We encourage everyone to bring their whole selves to work—to believe in their abilities, to freely express their creativity, and to contribute with their own uniqueness by wearing their true colors. We take care of one another and always prioritize health and wellbeing. We give our people the space and trust to learn, to try, to succeed, to collaborate, to think outside of the box, to make mistakes, and even to fail. And then we come together to try again.
From the minute you join, you have a voice. You find your space. You make an impact. We celebrate our victories, shout our successes, and are always eager to tackle new challenges. And we can’t wait to see all that’s to come.
About The Role
As the Vice President of Marketing, reporting directly to the CEO, you will build and lead FareHarbor’s first fully integrated global marketing organization. You’ll be responsible for partnering closely with our commercial teams and executing a marketing strategy that layers a strong inbound and lifecycle engine on top of our proven outbound sales and local partnership motion.
You will unify and lead a global team across Lead Generation, Product Marketing, and Client Engagement to (1) accelerate the acquisition of high-quality new clients and (2) deepen client engagement by helping them better understand and leverage our products to drive revenue growth. Your work will directly impact pipeline, revenue, and the growth of FareHarbor across all regions.
What You’ll Do Here
Own the demand engine and pipeline impact
Deliver a step-change increase in high-intent demand globally: driving a 10x expansion in qualified pipeline across all segments and regions.
Create integrated, multi-channel growth programs (digital, content, SEO/SEM, events, partners) that consistently generate sales-ready opportunities and materially shorten the path to revenue.
Improve revenue conversion by ensuring prospects move smoothly from first touch to closed-won: driven by clear qualification standards, intelligent scoring, and seamless collaboration with Sales.
Strengthen positioning, product marketing, and client engagement
Lead Product Marketing to define clear, differentiated messaging and positioning for FareHarbor’s platform, solutions, and key features.
Partner with Product and Commercial teams to plan and execute go-to-market for new products and enhancements, ensuring commercial impact from launches.
Develop and execute an industry engagement strategy (for prospects and clients) that strengthens FareHarbor’s position in the tours & activities ecosystem offline and online.
Champion the voice of the customer and ensure marketing reflects the realities and aspirations of operators and partners who rely on FareHarbor.
Oversee Product Marketing and internal enablement to ensure clear product positioning, effective go to market execution, and strong cross-team education that empowers Sales, CX, and Support to articulate and deliver FareHarbor’s value.
Shape and lead the marketing organization
Consolidate the current Product Marketing, Lead Generation, and Client Engagement under one unified marketing function with clear roles, processes, and accountability.
Recruit, develop, and inspire a high-performing global marketing organization, fostering a culture of accountability, creativity, and continuous improvement.
Define the operating model, workflows, and cadences that enable marketing to work effectively with Sales, Product, and Commercial (sales + account management) departments.
Requirements
10 to 15 years of progressive B2B SaaS marketing experience, including at least 5 years leading teams across areas like demand gen, product marketing, and client engagement.
A clear record of driving pipeline and revenue, improving conversion rates, lifting marketing sourced pipeline, and optimizing CAC and CLTV.
Experience marketing B2B products both within and outside the US and Canada, plus hands on experience with HubSpot and AI powered lead gen and marketing tools.
Strong demand gen skills for both inbound leads and client upsell and cross sell, including performance marketing, content, events, and automation.
A history of building and leading high performing teams in fast growing environments, raising the bar for the people around you, and creating and delivering strong departmental roadmaps.
Strong analytical and communication skills, and a proven ability to work with and influence senior leaders.
Why join FareHarbor
Impact at scale: Shape the next chapter of growth for a SaaS company already at meaningful scale, with a strong product and GTM foundation.
Build something lasting: Create a modern, integrated marketing engine in a space where there is still huge room for innovation and growth.
Global collaboration: Work with talented teams across Europe, North America, and Asia Pacific, serving customers in the most exciting segment of travel.
Benefits
Global leave benefit
22 weeks paid parental leave
2 weeks paid grandparent leave
Extended care and bereavement leave
Life insurance policy
Pension Plan
Central Amsterdam Location
Discount CZ insurance
Working in a multicultural environment - 45 different nationalities
Commuting allowance for public transport & subsidized lunch
Wellness benefits (Headspace subscription & wellness webinars)
Hybrid friendly
Work-from-home assistance
Educational Opportunities
Individual skill development & growth programming
Social hours & events and team-building
26 vacation days per year

title: Head of Engineering
description:
How You Keep The Engine Running With Us
As Head of Engineering, you are responsible for the development, execution and continuous improvement of all engineering activities for large-scale projects in the VVIP and Special Mission Aircraft (SMA) market. Your scope covers the full lifecycle — from conceptual design through to successful delivery of products and services to the customer.
In addition, the Engineering organization provides modification engineering, engineering services and ongoing support for the Fokker fleet. You lead the Engineering department across Woensdrecht and Hoofddorp, managing approximately 50 engineers and specialists, while ensuring that critical knowledge and expertise in aircraft and systems design is secured and continuously developed.
Position in the Organisation
You report hierarchically to the BU Director CES and lead a team of three Engineering Team Leaders. You act as the primary representative of Engineering within the CES leadership team and towards internal and external stakeholders.
Your Role & Responsibilities
As Head of Engineering, you ensure that engineering teams are fully enabled to execute work packages, projects and services within agreed schedule, budget, quality and technical requirements, while meeting both internal and external customer expectations. You actively shape engineering strategy and provide recommendations to the BU Director regarding process improvements, investments and capability development to maintain market competitiveness.
You manage the implementation of new engineering processes and procedures, including training and employee development programs, and decide on temporary assignment of engineers and outsourcing of defined work packages when required. You support proposal and bid phases and participate in key project, technical and design reviews.
A core responsibility is the development, cross-training and long-term capability growth of engineers and specialists. You challenge resource allocation in terms of volume and expertise to ensure efficient, on-time and high-quality delivery. You provide input to the Operational Plan and are accountable for achieving Engineering-related OP targets.
You represent Engineering in management meetings, strategic sessions, project reviews and design reviews, and ensure that all team members comply with company procedures, safety, quality, environmental, security and export compliance regulations.
Collaboration & Communication
You operate in a highly collaborative environment and work closely with Procurement, Logistics/Operations, Production, Component Maintenance and Commercial teams, including frequent interaction with project sponsors and customers. You consult with Project Managers, Senior Specialists and Compliance Verification Engineers on technical matters and maintain regular alignment with peer managers and the BU Director CES.
How You Are Valuable To Us
You are responsible for reporting on:
Operational Plan targets and KPIs
Budgets, EAC and regular management progress reports
Forward load and capacity planning
Weekly accomplishments and productive hours
Training needs and capability development
Knowledge & Experience Required
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
Proven experience in managing engineering projects and teams
Strong knowledge of change management and process improvement
Demonstrated leadership skills (both hard and soft skills)
Solid background in project management
Proven ability to motivate, empower and develop employees
Knowledge of design organisation requirements, norms, regulations and processes
Familiarity with company regulations related to safety, quality, environment, security and export compliance
Proficiency in English and Dutch (minimum B2 level)
Where you will be working
With over a century of experience, innovation, knowledge, and expertise flow through our veins. Our cross-departmental approach and customized solutions leave a mark on the future of aerospace innovation. With our warm culture, we are more than just colleagues; we are a team of friends dedicated to both enjoyment and development. This passion and continuous improvement are what make our employees commit to Fokker Services Group for the long term.
We are pioneers with courage. It's no coincidence that we are a global player in aircraft maintenance and development. With passionate colleagues, we work on the most innovative and advanced solutions to make the aerospace sector more sustainable and efficient. We continue to push the boundaries of what is possible, ensuring that aircraft remain where they belong: in the sky!
What We Offer
A competitive salary commensurate with your knowledge and experience;
27-29 holiday days and 13 ADV leave days per year (when working full-time, 40 hours);
A challenging international working environment;
Professional and personal growth opportunities and a lot of autonomy;
Company laptop and phone;
An insider's look into the innovative world of aviation;
A lot of room for professional and personal growth;
Fun colleagues (trust us, we're not biased).
